src_text: If a substance must move into the cell against its concentration gradient—that is, if the concentration of the substance inside the cell is greater than its concentration in the extracellular fluid (and vice versa)—the cell must use energy to move the substance.
tgt_text: Agar modda hujayra ichiga oʻzining konsentrasiya gradientiga qarshi harakat qilishi kerak boʻlsa, yaʼni hujayra ichidagi moddaning konsentratsiyasi uning hujayradan tashqari suyuqlikdagi konsentratsiyasidan katta boʻlsa (va aksincha), hujayra moddani harakatlantirish uchun energiya sarflashi kerak.

src_text: Other mechanisms transport much larger molecules.
tgt_text: Boshqa mexanizmlar ancha katta molekulalarni tashiydi.

src_text: The interior of living cells is electrically negative with respect to the extracellular fluid in which they are bathed, and at the same time, cells have higher concentrations of potassium (K + ) and lower concentrations of sodium (Na + ) than does the extracellular fluid.
tgt_text: Tirik hujayralarning ichki qismi ular cho'miladigan hujayradan tashqari suyuqlikka nisbatan elektr manfiydir va shu bilan birga, hujayralar hujayradan tashqari suyuqlikka nisbatan kaliy (K +) ko'proq va natriy (Na +) kontsentratsiyasi kamroq bo'ladi.

src_text: So in a living cell, the concentration gradient of Na + tends to drive it into the cell, and the electrical gradient of Na + (a positive ion) also tends to drive it inward to the negatively charged interior.
tgt_text: Shunday qilib, tirik hujayrada Na + ning konsentratsiya gradienti uni hujayra ichiga olib kirishga intiladi va uning elektr gradienti (musbat ion) ham uni manfiy zaryadlangan ichki qismga olib boradi.

src_text: The situation is more complex, however, for other elements such as potassium.
tgt_text: Ammo, kaliy kabi boshqa elementlar uchun vaziyat murakkabroq.

src_text: To move substances against a concentration or electrochemical gradient, the cell must use energy.
tgt_text: Moddalarni kontsentratsiyaga yoki elektrokimyoviy gradientga qarshi harakatlantirish uchun hujayra energiyadan foydalanishi kerak.

src_text: Small substances constantly pass through plasma membranes.
tgt_text: Kichik moddalar doimiy ravishda plazma membranalari orqali o'tadi.

src_text: Secondary active transport describes the movement of material that is due to the electrochemical gradient established by primary active transport that does not directly require ATP.
tgt_text: Ikkilamchi faol transport to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ATPni talab qilmaydi: buning o'rniga, bu birlamchi faol transport tomonidan o'rnatilgan elektrokimyoviy gradient tufayli materialning harakati.

src_text: A uniporter carries one specific ion or molecule.
tgt_text: Uniporter o'ziga xos ion yoki molekulani tashiydi.

src_text: One of the most important pumps in animals cells is the sodium-potassium pump (Na + -K + ATPase), which maintains the electrochemical gradient (and the correct concentrations of Na + and K + ) in living cells.
tgt_text: Hayvon hujayralaridagi eng muhim nasoslardan biri bu tirik hujayralardagi elektrokimyoviy gradyanni (va Na + va K + ning to'g'ri kontsentratsiyasini) saqlaydigan natriy -kaliyli nasos (Na + -K + ATPaza).

src_text: - With the enzyme oriented towards the interior of the cell, the carrier has a high affinity for sodium ions.
tgt_text: - Ferment hujayraning ichki qismiga yo'naltirilganligi sababli, tashuvchi natriy ionlari uchun yuqori yaqinlikka ega.

src_text: - As a result, the carrier changes shape and re-orients itself towards the exterior of the membrane.
tgt_text: - Natijada, tashuvchi shakli o'zgaradi va o'zini membrananing tashqi tomoniga yo'naltiradi.

src_text: Subsequently, the low-energy phosphate group detaches from the carrier.
tgt_text: Keyinchalik, past energiyali fosfat guruhi tashuvchidan ajralib chiqadi.

src_text: The sodium-potassium pump is, therefore, an electrogenic pump (a pump that creates a charge imbalance), creating an electrical imbalance across the membrane and contributing to the membrane potential.
tgt_text: Natriy-kaliyli nasos, shuning uchun, elektrojenik nasos (zaryad muvozanatini buzadigan nasos) bo'lib, membrana bo'ylab elektr muvozanatini buzadi va membrana potentsialiga hissa qo'shadi.

src_text: DNA polymerase act as a catalyst in DNA replication and hence is very essential.

src_text: DNA polymerase 1 is essential for DNA replication and it is also called as Pol 1.
tgt_text: DNK polimeraza 1 DNK replikatsiyasi uchun zarur va uni Pol 1 deb ham atashadi.

src_text: DNA polymerase 3 is essential for pro-karyotic DNA replication and was discovered by Thomas Kornberg and Malcolm Gefter.

src_text: DNA polymerase 3 is also called as holoenzyme and it is the most essential component of replisome.

src_text: DNA polymerase 1 functions helps in DNA replication.

src_text: It is used for molecular biology research.

src_text: The main value of the periodic table is the ability to predict the chemical properties of an element based on its location on the table.

src_text: The table has also found wide application in physics, biology, engineering, and industry.

src_text: The periodic table lists elements by atomic number, which is the number of protons in every atom of that element.
tgt_text: Davriy jadvalda elementlarning har bir atomidagi protonlar soni ko'rsatilgan atom raqami ko'rsatilgan.

src_text: Atoms of an atomic number may have varying numbers of neutrons (isotopes) and electrons (ions), yet remain the same chemical element.
tgt_text: Atom raqamidagi atomlar har xil miqdordagi neytronlar (izotoplar) va elektronlar (ionlar) ga ega bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bir xil kimyoviy element bo'lib qolaveradi.

src_text: Groups include elements having the same electron configuration in their outer shell, which results in group elements sharing similar chemical properties.
tgt_text: Guruhlar tashqi qobig'ida bir xil elektron konfiguratsiyaga ega bo'lgan elementlarni o'z ichiga oladi, buning natijasida guruh elementlari o'xshash kimyoviy xossalarga ega.

src_text: The electrons in the outer shell are termed valence electrons.
tgt_text: Tashqi qobiqdagi elektronlar deyiladi valent elektronlar.

src_text: Valence electrons determine the properties and chemical reactivity of the element and participate in chemical bonding.
tgt_text: Valent elektronlar elementning xossalarini va kimyoviy reaktivligini aniqlaydi va kimyoviy bog'lanishda ishtirok etadi.

src_text: The Roman numeral and letter designations give the electron configuration for the valence electrons (e.g., the valence electron configuration of a group VA element will be s 2 p 3 with 5 valence electrons).
tgt_text: Rim raqami va harflari valent elektronlar uchun elektron konfiguratsiyasini beradi (masalan, VA guruhli valent elektron konfiguratsiyasi 5 valentli elektronlar bilan 2 p 3 bo'ladi).

src_text: A brief history of the periodic table
tgt_text: Davriy jadvalning qisqacha tarixi

src_text: The periodic table of elements is a common sight in classrooms, campus hallways and libraries, but it is more than a tabular organization of pure substances.
tgt_text: Elementlarning davriy jadvali sinflar, kampus koridorlari va kutubxonalarda keng tarqalgan ko'rinishdir, ammo bu toza moddalarning jadvalli tashkilotidan ham ko'proq.

src_text: Scientists can use the table to analyze reactivity among elements, predict chemical reactions, understand trends in periodic properties among different elements and speculate on the properties of those yet to be discovered.
tgt_text: Olimlar jadvaldan elementlar orasidagi reaktivlikni tahlil qilish, kimyoviy reaktsiyalarni bashorat qilish, turli elementlar orasidagi davriy xususiyatlarning tendentsiyalarini tushunish va hali kashf qilinmaganlarning xususiyatlari haqida taxmin qilish uchun foydalanishlari mumkin.

src_text: The modern periodic table arranges the elements by their atomic numbers and periodic properties.
tgt_text: Zamonaviy davriy jadval elementlarni atom raqamlari va davriy xususiyatlariga ko'ra tartibga soladi.

src_text: Several scientists worked over almost a century to assemble the elements into this format.
tgt_text: Bir necha olimlar deyarli bir asr mobaynida elementlarni ushbu formatga yig'ish uchun harakat qilishdi.

src_text: Forty years later, German physicist Johann Wolfang Döbereiner observed similarities in physical and chemical properties of certain elements.
tgt_text: Qirq yil o'tgach, nemis fizigi Yoxann Volfang Döbereiner ba'zi elementlarning fizik va kimyoviy xossalarida o'xshashliklarni kuzatdi.

src_text: They concluded that hydrogen would be assigned the atomic weight of 1 and the atomic weight of other elements would be decided by comparison with hydrogen.
tgt_text: Ular vodorodga 1 atom og'irligi va boshqa elementlarning atom og'irligi beriladi degan xulosaga kelishdi. vodorod bilan solishtirish orqali hal qilinadi.

src_text: Mendeleev predicted the properties of some undiscovered elements and gave them names such as "eka-aluminium" for an element with properties similar to aluminium.
tgt_text: Mendeleyev kashf qilinmagan ba'zi elementlarning xususiyatlarini bashorat qilib, ularga alyuminiyga o'xshash xususiyatlar uchun & quoteka-alyuminiy & quot kabi nomlar bergan.

src_text: He left gaps for undiscovered elements but never predicted their properties.
tgt_text: U ochilmagan elementlar uchun bo'shliqlar qoldirdi, lekin ularning xususiyatlarini hech qachon bashorat qilmagan.

src_text: The Royal Society of London awarded the Davy Medal in 1882 to both Mendeleev and Meyer.
tgt_text: London Qirollik Jamiyati 1882 yilda Mendeleev va Meyerni Davi medali bilan taqdirladi.

src_text: In the periodic table, the horizontal rows are called periods, with metals in the extreme left and nonmetals on the right.

src_text: As Aristotle says in the Nicomachean Ethics: "at the right times, about the right things, towards the right people, for the right end, and in the right way, is the intermediate and best condition, and this is proper to virtue."[13] This is not simply splitting the difference between two extremes.
tgt_text: Aristotel Nikomachean Etikasida aytganidek: „Toʻgʻri vaqtda, toʻgʻri narsalar haqida, toʻgʻri odamlarga, toʻgʻri maqsad va toʻgʻri yoʻlda — bu oraliq va eng yaxshi shartdir va bu fazilatga toʻgʻri keladi“.[12] Bu shunchaki ikkita ekstremal oʻrtasidagi farqni ajratish emas.

src_text: The Epicureans teach that the emotions, dispositions and habits related to virtue (and vice) have a cognitive component and are based on true (or false) beliefs.
tgt_text: Epikurchilar fazilat (va yomonlik) bilan bogʻliq his-tuygʻular, moyilliklar va odatlar kognitiv tarkibiy qismga ega va haqiqiy (yoki notoʻgʻri) eʼtiqodlarga asoslanadi, deb oʻrgatadi.

src_text: In this way, wisdom is the central part of virtue.
tgt_text: Shunday qilib, donolik fazilatning markaziy qismidir.

src_text: Romans distinguished between the spheres of private and public life, and thus, virtues were also divided between those considered to be in the realm of private family life (as lived and taught by the paterfamilias), and those expected of an upstanding Roman citizen.
tgt_text: Rimliklar shaxsiy va jamoat hayoti sohalarini ajratib koʻrsatishgan va shuning uchun fazilatlar shaxsiy oilaviy hayot sohasida (paterfamilias tomonidan yashagan va oʻrgatganidek) deb hisoblanganlar va taniqli Rim fuqarosidan kutilganlar oʻrtasida boʻlingan.

src_text: However, the starting nucleus is always diploid and the nuclei that result at the end of a meiotic cell division are haploid.
tgt_text: Biroq, boshlang'ich yadro har doim diploid va meiotik hujayra bo'linishi oxirida yuzaga keladigan yadrolar haploiddir.

src_text: The crossover events are the first source of genetic variation in the nuclei produced by meiosis.
tgt_text: Krossover hodisalari meioz natijasida hosil bo'lgan yadrolardagi genetik o'zgarishlarning birinchi manbaidir.

src_text: The sister recombinant chromatid has a combination of maternal and paternal genes that did not exist before the crossover.
tgt_text: Opa-singil rekombinant xromatidi krossoverdan oldin mavjud bo'lmagan onalik va otalik genlarining kombinatsiyasiga ega.

src_text: This randomness is the physical basis for the creation of the second form of genetic variation in offspring.
tgt_text: Bu tasodifiylik nasldagi genetik o'zgaruvchanlikning ikkinchi shaklini yaratish uchun jismoniy asosdir.

src_text: The father provides the other set of 23 chromosomes in the sperm that fertilizes the egg.
tgt_text: Ota tuxumni urug'lantiradigan spermada 23 ta xromosomaning boshqa to'plamini beradi.

src_text: In metaphase I, these pairs line up at the midway point between the two poles of the cell to form the metaphase plate.
tgt_text: I metafazada bu juftlar hujayraning ikki qutbi orasidagi oʻrta nuqtada birikadi va metafaza plastinkasini hosil qiladi.

src_text: Given these two mechanisms, it is highly unlikely that any two haploid cells resulting from meiosis will have the same genetic composition ([link]).
tgt_text: Ushbu ikkita mexanizmni hisobga olgan holda, meioz natijasida hosil bo'lgan ikkita haploid hujayraning bir xil genetik tarkibga ega bo'lishi ehtimoldan yiroq emas (quyidagi rasmga qarang).

src_text: This cell plate will ultimately lead to the formation of cell walls that separate the two daughter cells.
tgt_text: Ushbu hujayra plitasi oxir-oqibat ikkita qiz hujayrani ajratib turadigan hujayra devorlarining shakllanishiga olib keladi.

src_text: Therefore, only one full set of the chromosomes is present.
tgt_text: Shuning uchun xromosomalarning faqat bitta to'liq to'plami mavjud.

src_text: Meiosis II is not a reduction division because although there are fewer copies of the genome in the resulting cells, there is still one set of chromosomes, as there was at the end of meiosis I.
tgt_text: Meyoz II reduksiya bo'linishi emas, chunki hosil bo'lgan hujayralarda genomning nusxalari kamroq bo'lsa-da, I meiozning oxirida bo'lgani kabi, hali ham bitta xromosomalar to'plami mavjud.

src_text: The difficulty lies in the clear differences between meiosis I and mitosis.
tgt_text: Qiyinchilik meyoz I va mitoz o'rtasidagi aniq farqlarda yotadi.

src_text: There are other approaches to understanding the evolution of meiosis in progress.
tgt_text: Davom etayotgan meioz evolyutsiyasini tushunish uchun boshqa yondashuvlar mavjud.

src_text: Marilee Ramesh and colleagues 2 compared the genes involved in meiosis in protists to understand when and where meiosis might have evolved.
tgt_text: Marili Ramesh va uning hamkasblari 3 protistlarda meyozda ishtirok etgan genlarni meyoz qachon va qayerda rivojlanishi mumkinligini tushunish uchun solishtirdilar.

src_text: Although research is still ongoing, recent scholarship into meiosis in protists suggests that some aspects of meiosis may have evolved later than others.
tgt_text: Tadqiqotlar hali ham davom etayotgan bo'lsa-da, protistlarda meioz bo'yicha yaqinda o'tkazilgan tadqiqot meyozning ba'zi jihatlari boshqalarga qaraganda kechroq rivojlangan bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.

src_text: This kind of genetic comparison can tell us what aspects of meiosis are the oldest and what cellular processes they may have borrowed from in earlier cells.

src_text: Choose a transplant center
tgt_text: Transplantatsiya markazini tanlang

src_text: We provide detailed information on U.S. transplant centers to help you and your doctors choose the transplant center that is best for you.
tgt_text: Sizga va sizning shifokorlaringizga sizga eng mos keladigan transplantatsiya markazini tanlashda yordam berish uchun biz AQSh transplantatsiya markazlari haqida batafsil ma'lumot beramiz.

src_text: A transplant center is a hospital that has a blood or marrow transplant program.
tgt_text: Transplantatsiya markazi - bu qon yoki ilik transplantatsiyasi dasturiga ega bo'lgan shifoxona.

src_text: Many of these centers are part of the NMDP* Network so they meet specific guidelines for quality care.
tgt_text: Ushbu markazlarning aksariyati NMDP* tarmog'ining bir qismidir, shuning uchun ular sifatli parvarish bo'yicha maxsus ko'rsatmalarga javob beradi.

src_text: There are also many international transplant centers in the NMDP Network.
tgt_text: NMDP tarmog'ida ko'plab xalqaro transplantatsiya markazlari ham mavjud.

src_text: To find a center that is best for you, work with your doctor and insurance company.
tgt_text: Sizga eng mos keladigan markazni topish uchun, shifokoringiz va sug'urta kompaniyangiz bilan hamkorlik qiling.

src_text: Some important factors in choosing a transplant center include:
tgt_text: Transplantatsiya markazini tanlashda ba'zi muhim omillar quyidagilardir:

src_text: Insurance coverage – Your insurance company may require you go to a certain transplant center.
tgt_text: Sug'urta qoplamasi - Sizning sug'urta kompaniyangiz ma'lum transplantatsiya markaziga borishingizni talab qilishi mumkin.

src_text: Your doctor – Your doctor may recommend specific transplant centers.
tgt_text: Sizning shifokoringiz - Shifokoringiz maxsus transplantatsiya markazlarini tavsiya qilishi mumkin.

src_text: Contact the transplant center financial coordinator to learn more about their costs.
tgt_text: Ularning xarajatlari haqida ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun transplantatsiya markazining moliyaviy koordinatori bilan bog'laning.

src_text: Consider how far the transplant center is from your home.
tgt_text: Transplantatsiya markazi sizning uyingizdan qanchalik uzoqda ekanligini o'ylab ko'ring.

src_text: Contact the transplant center to see if there are low cost housing options for you and your caregiver.
tgt_text: Siz va qarovchingiz uchun arzon uy-joy imkoniyatlari mavjudligini bilish uchun transplantatsiya markaziga murojaat qiling.

src_text: The length of time can vary depending on your situation.
tgt_text: Vaqtning davomiyligi sizning vaziyatingizga qarab farq qilishi mumkin.

src_text: Many of these services are in the center listing or you can contact the transplant center to learn more about them.
tgt_text: Ushbu xizmatlarning aksariyati markaz ro'yxatida yoki ular haqida ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun transplantatsiya markaziga murojaat qilishingiz mumkin.

src_text: Find out how many patients with your disease that transplant center has treated.
tgt_text: Transplantatsiya markazi sizning kasalligingiz bilan qancha bemorni davolaganini bilib oling.

src_text: To learn more about a transplant center it is helpful to contact the center and ask specific questions.
tgt_text: Transplantatsiya markazi haqida ko'proq bilish uchun markazga murojaat qilish va aniq savollar berish foydali bo'ladi.

src_text: Use the Transplant Center Worksheet (PDF) to gather the answers to some of these questions:
tgt_text: Quyidagi savollarga javoblarni yig'ish uchun Transplantatsiya markazi ish varag'idan (PDF) foydalaning:

src_text: - Does a patient see the same transplant doctor throughout the transplant process?
tgt_text: - Bemor transplantatsiya jarayonida bir xil transplantatsiya shifokoriga murojaat qiladimi?

src_text: - How long is the average hospital stay?
tgt_text: - O'rtacha kasalxonada qolish muddati qancha?

src_text: Can guests or parents stay overnight?
tgt_text: Mehmonlar yoki ota-onalar bir kechada qolishlari mumkinmi?

src_text: Are tutoring services available?
tgt_text: Repetitorlik xizmatlari mavjudmi?

src_text: - Are patients or caregivers able to connect to the Internet from their rooms?
tgt_text: - Bemorlar yoki parvarish qiluvchilar o'z xonalaridan Internetga ulana oladimi?

src_text: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HRSA) has patient survival and transplant data for transplants done in the U.S. These include 100-day, 1-year and 3-year survival by disease.
tgt_text: AQSh Sog'liqni saqlash va odamlarga xizmat ko'rsatish departamenti (HRSA) AQShda o'tkazilgan transplantatsiyalar uchun bemorlarning omon qolishi va transplantatsiyasi to'g'risida ma'lumotlarga ega, ular orasida kasallikning 100 kunlik, 1 yillik va 3 yillik omon qolishi kiradi.

src_text: *The National Marrow Donor Program® (NMDP) Network includes transplant centers in the U.S. and around the world.
tgt_text: *Miliy iligi donorlari dasturi (NMDP) tarmog'i AQSh va butun dunyodagi transplantatsiya markazlarini o'z ichiga oladi.

src_text: Our BMT Patient Navigators can answer your questions about choosing a transplant center.
tgt_text: Bizning BMT Bemor Navigatorlarimiz transplantatsiya markazini tanlash bo'yicha savollaringizga javob berishlari mumkin.

src_text: This type of transplant can be an intensive procedure, and recovery can take a long time.
tgt_text: Ushbu turdagi transplantatsiya intensiv protsedura bo'lishi mumkin va tiklanish uzoq vaqt talab qilishi mumkin.

tgt_text: Pinterestda baham ko'ring, ko'p hollarda yaqin oila a'zosi donor hisoblanadi.

src_text: - red blood cells, which carry oxygen throughout the body
tgt_text: - qizil qon tanachalari, ular butun tanada kislorod tashiydi

src_text: - white blood cells, which help fight off infection
tgt_text: - oq qon hujayralari, ular infektsiyani engishga yordam beradi

src_text: - platelets, which create clots to prevent excessive bleeding
tgt_text: - trombotsitlar, ular ortiqcha qon ketishining oldini olish uchun pıhtılar hosil qiladi

src_text: If a medical condition — such as one that damages the blood or immune system — prevents the body from creating healthy blood cells, a person may need a bone marrow transplant.
tgt_text: Agar biron bir kasallik, masalan, qon yoki immunitet tizimiga zarar etkazsa, tananing sog'lom qon hujayralarini yaratishiga to'sqinlik qilsa, odamga suyak iligi transplantatsiyasi kerak bo'ladi.

src_text: A person with any of the following conditions may be a candidate for a bone marrow transplant:
tgt_text: Quyidagi holatlardan biriga ega bo'lgan odam suyak iligi transplantatsiyasiga nomzod bo'lishi mumkin:

src_text: - bone marrow damage due to chemotherapy or radiation therapy for cancer
tgt_text: - kemoterapi yoki saraton uchun radiatsiya terapiyasi tufayli suyak iligi shikastlanishi

src_text: There are three types of bone marrow transplant, based on where the healthy bone marrow cells come from.
tgt_text: Sog'lom suyak iligi hujayralari qaerdan kelib chiqqanligiga qarab, suyak iligi transplantatsiyasining uchta turi mavjud.

src_text: In many cases, the donor is a close family member, such as a sibling or parent.
tgt_text: Ko'p hollarda donor yaqin oila a'zosi, masalan, aka-uka yoki ota-onadir.

src_text: In a procedure called an autologous transplant, the doctor will take healthy blood stem cells from the person being treated and replace these cells later, after removing any damaged cells in the sample.
tgt_text: Autolog transplantatsiya deb nomlangan protsedurada, shifokor davolanayotgan odamdan sog'lom qonli ildiz hujayralarini oladi va namunadagi shikastlangan hujayralarni olib tashlagach, keyinchalik bu hujayralarni almashtiradi.

src_text: Before a bone marrow transplant, the doctor will run tests to determine the best type of procedure.
tgt_text: Suyak iligi transplantatsiyasidan oldin shifokor eng yaxshi protsedura turini aniqlash uchun testlarni o'tkazadi.

src_text: The person will then undergo other treatment, which may involve chemotherapy, radiation, or a combination of the two.
tgt_text: Keyin odam kimyoterapiya, radiatsiya yoki ikkalasining kombinatsiyasini o'z ichiga olishi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa davolanishdan o'tadi.

src_text: These procedures typically destroy bone marrow cells as well as cancer cells.
tgt_text: Ushbu protseduralar odatda suyak iligi hujayralarini, shuningdek saraton hujayralarini yo'q qiladi.

src_text: Would a person who receives a bone marrow transplant essentially now have two potential sources of DNA, the original pre-existing in the body's cells and now another from the donor cells of the bone marrow?
tgt_text: Suyak iligi transplantatsiyasini olgan odam, aslida, DNKning ikkita potentsial manbaiga ega bo'larmidi, asl nusxasi tananing hujayralarida, keyin suyak iligining donor hujayralaridan.

src_text: You are exactly right.
tgt_text: Siz to'g'ri aytasiz.

src_text: What I mean is that the DNA in their blood is different than the DNA in the rest of their cells.
tgt_text: Aytmoqchi bo'lganim shundaki, ularning qonidagi DNK qolgan hujayralardagi DNKdan farq qiladi.

src_text: In theory, this could complicate a criminal investigation.
tgt_text: Nazariy jihatdan, bu jinoiy tergovni murakkablashtirishi mumkin.

src_text: It can also be used to figure out fertility issues.
tgt_text: Bundan tashqari, tug'ilish muammolarini aniqlash uchun ham foydalanish mumkin.

src_text: DNA testing can be done by collecting DNA from very small amounts of human hair, bone, skin tissue, saliva, semen, and blood.
tgt_text: DNK tekshiruvi juda oz miqdordagi inson sochlari, suyaklari, teri to'qimalari, tupurik, sperma va qondan DNK yig'ish yo'li bilan amalga oshirilishi mumkin.

src_text: Scientists have identified 13 places on our DNA that are very different between individuals.
tgt_text: Olimlar DNKimizda odamlar o'rtasida juda farq qiladigan 13 joyni aniqladilar.

src_text: They use those areas to produce profiles that can distinguish one individual from another.
tgt_text: Ular bir odamni boshqasidan ajrata oladigan profillarni ishlab chiqarish uchun o'sha joylardan foydalanadilar.

src_text: Sometimes people are born with two different sets of DNA (click here to learn more).
tgt_text: Ba'zida odamlar ikki xil DNK to'plami bilan tug'iladi (ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun shu erni bosing).

src_text: And sometimes a person develops different DNA later in life.
tgt_text: Va ba'zida odamda keyinchalik hayotda turli xil DNKlar paydo bo'ladi.

src_text: A common example is small DNA changes that happen in some of our cells over time.
tgt_text: Vaqt o'tishi bilan ba'zi hujayralarimizda sodir bo'ladigan kichik DNK o'zgarishlari oddiy misol.

src_text: Mosaics usually aren't a problem because DNA tests look at 13 different spots.
tgt_text: Mozaika odatda muammo emas, chunki DNK testlari 13 xil nuqtani ko'rib chiqadi.

src_text: It can treat people with various blood and bone marrow diseases.
tgt_text: U turli qon va suyak iligi kasalliklari bilan og'rigan odamlarni davolashi mumkin.

src_text: It is also used in the treatment of some forms of cancer.
tgt_text: Bundan tashqari, u saratonning ayrim shakllarini davolashda ishlatiladi.

src_text: This is often done with chemotherapy or radiation.
tgt_text: Bu ko'pincha kimyoterapiya yoki nurlanish yordamida amalga oshiriladi.

src_text: These blood stem cells are responsible for making our blood.
tgt_text: Bu qon hujayralari bizning qonimizni ishlab chiqarish uchun javobgardir.

src_text: Our blood cells need to be replaced constantly (this is why a blood transfusion only temporarily changes the DNA profile of our blood).
tgt_text: Bizning qon hujayralarini doimiy ravishda almashtirish kerak (shuning uchun qon quyish qonimizning DNK profilini vaqtincha o'zgartiradi).

src_text: This means their blood DNA profile will be a mixture of both the donor and recipient.
tgt_text: Bu ularning qon DNK profili donor va qabul qiluvchining aralashmasi bo'lishini anglatadi.

src_text: Understanding the nervous system: main features
tgt_text: Asab tizimini tushunish: asosiy xususiyatlari

src_text: It is in the central nervous system that our thoughts, emotions occur, our memories are archived, and all sorts of sensory stimulation occur.
tgt_text: Aynan markaziy asab tizimida bizning fikrlarimiz, hissiyotlarimiz paydo bo'ladi, xotiralarimiz arxivlanadi va turli xil hissiy stimulyatsiyalar yuzaga keladi.

src_text: It is subdivided into somatic nervous system, autonomic system and enteric nervous system (involuntary functioning).
tgt_text: Somatik asab tizimiga, avtonom tizimga va enteral asab tizimiga (majburiy ishlash) bo'linadi.

src_text: The somatic nervous system is responsible for transmitting the information of our senses (hearing, sight, taste, smell) to the CNS (central nervous system), and also for conducting the nervous impulses of the CNS to skeletal muscles.
tgt_text: Somatik asab tizimi bizning sezgiimizdan (eshitish, ko'rish, ta'm, hid) ma'lumotni markaziy asab tizimiga (markaziy asab tizimi) uzatish, shuningdek markaziy asab impulslarini skelet mushaklariga o'tkazish uchun javobgardir.

src_text: In the case of motor responses, this action will be voluntary as it can be consciously controlled.
tgt_text: Dvigatel reaktsiyalari holatida ushbu harakat ixtiyoriy bo'ladi, chunki ongli ravishda boshqarilishi mumkin.

src_text: The autonomic nervous system sends information from visceral organs, such as the lung and stomach, to the central nervous system (CNS).
tgt_text: Avtonom asab tizimi o'pka va oshqozon kabi visseral organlardan ma'lumotlarni markaziy asab tizimiga (CNS) yuboradi.

src_text: The enteric nervous system, located in the intestine, controls all nerve impulses that occur within the intestine.
tgt_text: Ichakda joylashgan enterik asab tizimi ichak ichida yuzaga keladigan barcha nerv impulslarini boshqaradi.

src_text: Its operation is also involuntary, as we cannot control it.
tgt_text: Uning ishlashi ham majburiy emas, chunki biz uni nazorat qila olmaymiz.

src_text: Generally speaking, we can understand that the nervous system performs numerous tasks in our body, and that through the electrical impulses that occur between its billions of neurons, it is able to connect with all parts of our body.
tgt_text: Umuman olganda, biz asab tizimining tanamizda ko'plab vazifalarni bajarishini va uning milliardlab neyronlar orasidagi elektr impulslari orqali tanamizning barcha qismlari bilan bog'lanishini tushunishimiz mumkin.

src_text: The branch of medicine that studies the nervous system is known as neurology.
tgt_text: Asab tizimini o'rganadigan tibbiyot sohasi nevrologiya deb nomlanadi.

src_text: Electromagnetic induction heating drum dryer is a kind of equipment widely used for drying food, coffee, soybeans, grains, nuts, peanuts, oil, dry goods and other agricultural and sideline products or food.
tgt_text: Elektromagnit indüksiyon isitish baraban quritgichi oziq-ovqat, qahva, soya, don, yong'oq, yeryong'oq, yog ', quruq mahsulotlar va boshqa qishloq xo'jaligi va yon mahsulotlar yoki oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarini quritish uchun keng qo'llaniladigan uskunadir.

src_text: Due to the problems of low thermal efficiency and high energy consumption in the traditional drum frying pan, electromagnetic induction heating drum dryers have appeared on the market, that is, the drum dryer is heated through the principle of electromagnetic induction heating.
tgt_text: An'anaviy tamburli qovurilgan idishda past issiqlik samaradorligi va yuqori energiya iste'moli muammolari tufayli elektromagnit induksion isitish barabanli quritgichlar bozorda paydo bo'ldi, ya'ni barabanli quritgich elektromagnit induksion isitish printsipi orqali isitiladi.

src_text: Since the drum dryer performs the motion of cutting magnetic field lines in the alternating magnetic field, an alternating current is generated inside the drum dryer.
tgt_text: Barabanli quritgich o'zgaruvchan magnit maydonda magnit maydon chiziqlarini kesish harakatini amalga oshirganligi sababli, barabanli quritgich ichida o'zgaruvchan tok hosil bo'ladi.

src_text: Because the heating source of the electromagnetic drum dryer is the drum dryer itself, it can effectively solve the problem of low thermal efficiency of coal furnaces, vaporization furnaces and electric heating devices.
tgt_text: Elektromagnit barabanli quritgichning isitish manbai baraban quritgichning o'zi bo'lgani uchun u ko'mir pechlari, bug'lanish pechlari va elektr isitish moslamalarining past issiqlik samaradorligi muammosini samarali hal qilishi mumkin.

src_text: However, due to the existence of multiple sets of electromagnetic coils, there is a strong alternating magnetic field around the electromagnetic induction heating drum dryer, and the alternating magnetic field will emit electromagnetic radiation.
tgt_text: Biroq, elektromagnit sariqlarning bir nechta to'plami mavjudligi sababli, elektromagnit indüksiyon isitish tamburli quritgich atrofida kuchli o'zgaruvchan magnit maydon mavjud va o'zgaruvchan magnit maydon elektromagnit nurlanishni chiqaradi.

src_text: When multiple electromagnetic drum dryers in the industry work at the same time, the electromagnetic radiation It will damage the internal instruments of the mechanical equipment, thereby affecting the service life of the mechanical equipment.

src_text: Wall Street is an eight-block-long street in the Financial District of Lower Manhattan in New York City.
tgt_text: Wall street — Nyu-York shahrida joylashgan Quyi Manxettenning moliyaviy okrugidagi sakkiz blokli koʻcha.

src_text: Wall Street was originally known in Dutch as "de Waalstraat" when it was part of New Amsterdam in the 17th century, though the origins of the name vary.
tgt_text: Wall street XVII asrda Nyu Amsterdamning tarkibida boʻlganida Golland tilida „de Waalstraat“ nomi bilan tanilgan, ammo bu nomning kelib chiqishi turlicha.

src_text: An actual wall existed on the street from 1685 to 1699.
tgt_text: Koʻchada haqiqiy devor 1685-yildan 1699-yilgacha mavjud boʻlgan.

src_text: In the early 19th century, both residences and businesses occupied the area, but increasingly business predominated, and New York City's financial industry became centered on Wall Street.
tgt_text: XIX asrning boshlarida bu hududni turar-joylar ham, korxonalar ham egallagan, ammo biznes tobora rivojlanib borgan va Nyu-Yorkning moliyaviy sanoati Wall streetda markazlashgan.

src_text: In the 20th century, several early skyscrapers were built on Wall Street, including 40 Wall Street, once the world's tallest building.
tgt_text: XX asrda Wall streetda bir nechta osmonoʻpar binolar qurilgan, jumladan, bir vaqtlar dunyodagi eng baland bino boʻlgan 40 Wall street shu koʻchada qad rostlagan.

src_text: The Wall Street area is home to the New York Stock Exchange, the world's largest stock exchange by total market capitalization, as well as the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, and many commercial banks and insurance companies.
tgt_text: Wall street hududida umumiy bozor kapitallashuvi boʻyicha dunyodagi eng yirik fond birjasi boʻlgan Nyu-York fond birjasi, shuningdek, Nyu-York Federal zaxira banki hamda koʻplab tijorat banklari va sugʻurta kompaniyalari joylashgan.

src_text: To support the business they did on the exchanges, many brokerage firms had offices nearby.
tgt_text: Birjalarda qilgan bizneslarini qoʻllab-quvvatlash uchun koʻplab brokerlik firmalarining yaqin atrofda ofislari boʻlgan.

src_text: Wall Street itself is a narrow and winding street running from the East River to Broadway and lined with skyscrapers, as well as the New York Stock Exchange Building and Federal Hall National Memorial and One Wall Street at its western end.
tgt_text: Wall street Sharqiy daryodan Brodveygacha choʻzilgan va osmonoʻpar binolar bilan oʻralgan tor burilishli koʻcha, shuningdek, Nyu-York fond birjasi binosi va Federal Xoll milliy yodgorligi va uning gʻarbiy burchagida One Wall Street binosi joylashgan.

src_text: The street is nearby multiple New York City Subway lines and ferry terminals and both the World Trade Center (1973–2001) site and the New World Trade Center.
tgt_text: Koʻcha yaqinida bir nechta metro liniyalari va parom terminallari, shuningdek, Jahon savdo markazi (1973-2001) va Yangi Jahon savdo markazi bor.

src_text: Another explanation is that the name of the street was indeed derived from a wall or rampart (actually a wooden palisade) on the northern boundary of the New Amsterdam settlement, built to protect against potential incursions from Native Americans, pirates, and the English.
tgt_text: Yana bir izoh shundaki, koʻcha nomi tubjoy amerikaliklar, qaroqchilar va inglizlarning bosqinlaridan himoya qilish uchun qurilgan Yangi Amsterdam aholi punktining shimoliy chegarasidagi devor yoki devordan (aslida yogʻoch palisada) olingan.

src_text: While the Dutch word "wal" can be translated as "rampart", it only appeared as "De Wal Straat" on some English maps of New Amsterdam, whereas other English maps show the name as "De Waal Straat".
tgt_text: Gollandcha „wal“ soʻzini „qoʻriqxona“ deb tarjima qilish mumkin boʻlsa-da, u Nyu Amsterdamning baʼzi ingliz xaritalarida faqat „De Val Straat“ sifatida paydo boʻlgan, boshqa ingliz xaritalarida esa bu nom „De Waal Straat“ sifatida koʻrsatilgan[2].

tgt_text: Nyu Jersi iqtisodiyotida[tahrir | manbasini tahrirlash]

src_text: After Wall Street firms started to expand westward in the 1980s into New Jersey,[80] the direct economic impacts of Wall Street activities have gone beyond New York City.
tgt_text: Wall street firmalari 1980-yillarda Nyu-Jersi shtatida gʻarbga yoʻnalganidan soʻng[67] Wall street faoliyatining toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri iqtisodiy taʼsiri Nyu-York shahridan tashqariga chiqdi.

src_text: The employment in the financial services industry, mostly in the "back office" roles, has become an important part of New Jersey's economy.[81] In 2009, the Wall Street employment wages were paid in the amount of almost $18.5 billion in the state.
tgt_text: Moliyaviy xizmatlar sanoatida, asosan, „arka ofis“ rollarida bandlik Nyu-Jersi iqtisodiyotining muhim qismiga aylandi[68]. 2009-yilda Wall streetdagi ish haqi shtatda deyarli 18,5 milliard dollar miqdorida toʻlangan.

src_text: The industry contributed $39.4 billion or 8.4 percent to the New Jersey's gross domestic product in the same year.[82]
tgt_text: Sanoat oʻsha yili Nyu-Jersi yalpi ichki mahsulotiga 39,4 milliard dollar yoki 8,4 foiz hissa qoʻshdi[69].

src_text: Additionally, New Jersey has become the main technology infrastructure to support the Wall Street operations.
tgt_text: Bundan tashqari, Nyu-Jersi Wall street operatsiyalarini qoʻllab-quvvatlash uchun asosiy texnologik infratuzilmaga aylandi.

src_text: The state lost 7.9 percent of its employment base from 2007 to 2010 in the financial services sector in the fallout of the subprime mortgage crisis.[82]
tgt_text: Shtat 2007-yildan 2010-yilgacha boʻlgan davrda ipoteka inqirozi natijasida moliyaviy xizmatlar sohasida bandlik bazasining 7,9 foizini yoʻqotgan[69].

src_text: Wilhelm Keitel was born in the village of Helmscherode near Gandersheim in the Duchy of Brunswick, Germany.
tgt_text: Vilgelm Keytel Germaniyaning Brunsvik gersogligidagi Gandersheym yaqinidagi Helmscherode qishlogʻida tugʻilgan.

src_text: Instead, he embarked on a military career in 1901, becoming an officer cadet of the Prussian Army.
tgt_text: Buning oʻrniga, u 1901-yilda Prussiya armiyasining ofitser kursanti boʻlib, harbiy karyerasini boshladi.

src_text: Three years later, he returned to field command.[5]
tgt_text: Uch yildan soʻng u yana dala qoʻmondonligiga qaytdi[2].

src_text: Now a lieutenant-colonel, Keitel was again assigned to the Ministry of War in 1929 and was soon promoted to Head of the Organizational Department ("T-2"), a post he held until Adolf Hitler took power in 1933.
tgt_text: Endi podpolkovnik Keytel 1929-yilda yana Urush vazirligiga oʻtkazildi va tez orada tashkiliy boʻlim boshligʻi („T-2“) lavozimiga tayinlanib, 1933-yilda Adolf Gitler hokimiyatni qoʻlga kiritgunga qadar bu lavozimda ishladi.

src_text: Keitel played an important role after the failed 20 July plot in 1944.
tgt_text: Keytel 1944-yil 20-iyuldagi muvaffaqiyatsiz fitnadan keyin muhim rol oʻynadi.

src_text: In April and May 1945, during the Battle of Berlin, Keitel called for counterattacks to drive back the Soviet forces and relieve Berlin.
tgt_text: 1945-yil aprel va may oylarida, Berlin jangi paytida Keytel Sovet qoʻshinlarini orqaga qaytarish va Berlinni ozod qilish uchun qarshi hujumga chaqirdi.

src_text: The plant cell is very similar to the animal cell, it differs only from the second cell in that it has some more organelles such as the cell wall and chloroplasts.
tgt_text: O'simlik xujayrasi hayvon hujayrasiga juda o'xshaydi, u faqat ikkinchi hujayradan farq qiladi, chunki uning tarkibida hujayra devori va xloroplastlar kabi bir qancha organellalar mavjud.

src_text: The cell wall is a unique feature of plant cells, it has the function of protecting and shaping adult cells.
tgt_text: Hujayra devori o'simlik hujayralarining o'ziga xos xususiyatidir, u kattalar hujayralarini himoya qilish va shakllantirish funktsiyasiga ega.

src_text: It is mainly formed by cellulose.
tgt_text: U asosan tsellyuloza orqali hosil bo'ladi.

src_text: Chloroplasts are chlorophyll plasts, they are responsible for photosynthesis.
tgt_text: Xloroplastlar xlorofil plastlardir, ular fotosintez uchun javobgardir.

src_text: As in the animal cell, the plant cell performs various types of functions for the purpose of maintaining its balance and life.
tgt_text: Hayvonlar hujayrasida bo'lgani kabi, o'simlik hujayrasi ham muvozanat va hayotni saqlab qolish uchun turli xil funktsiyalarni bajaradi.

src_text: Hormones are chemicals produced by endocrine glands or specialized neurons.
tgt_text: Gormonlar - bu endokrin bezlar yoki ixtisoslashgan neyronlar tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan kimyoviy moddalar.

src_text: They are extremely important for controlling the functioning of the human body.
tgt_text: Ular inson tanasining ishlashini boshqarish uchun juda muhimdir.

src_text: - Some hormones act as a chemical messenger, carrying information between cells.
tgt_text: - Ba'zi gormonlar hujayralar o'rtasida ma'lumot tashiydigan kimyoviy xabarchi vazifasini bajaradi.

src_text: - Others act to regulate organs and regions of the body.
tgt_text: - Boshqalar tananing organlari va mintaqalarini tartibga solish uchun harakat qilishadi.

src_text: Female hormone produced by the ovary.
tgt_text: Tuxumdon tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan ayol gormoni.

src_text: Female hormone produced by the corpus luteum.
tgt_text: Korpus luteum tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan ayol gormoni.

src_text: It acts on the regulation of appetite, sexual activity, sleep and circadian rhythm.
tgt_text: Tuyadi, jinsiy faoliyat, uyqu va sirkadiyalik ritmni tartibga solishga ta'sir qiladi.

src_text: - Vertebrate animals have about 50 hormones, which are produced by the endocrine glands.

src_text: - The word hormone originates from the Greek language and its meaning is "stimulate or stimulate".

src_text: As president, Wilson changed the nation's economic policies and led the United States into World War I in 1917.
tgt_text: Prezident sifatida Wilson mamlakatning iqtisodiy siyosatini oʻzgartirdi va 1917-yilda Qoʻshma Shtatlarni Birinchi jahon urushiga olib keldi.

src_text: He was the leading architect of the League of Nations, and his progressive stance on foreign policy came to be known as Wilsonianism.
tgt_text: U Millatlar ligasining yetakchi meʼmori boʻlgan va uning tashqi siyosatdagi ilgʻor pozitsiyasi Wilsonizm nomi bilan mashhur boʻldi.

src_text: Wilson grew up in the American South, mainly in Augusta, Georgia, during the Civil War and Reconstruction.
tgt_text: Wilson Amerikaning janubida, asosan, Gruziyaning Augusta shahrida fuqarolar urushi va qayta qurish davrida oʻsgan.

src_text: Wilson defeated incumbent Republican William Howard Taft and third-party nominee Theodore Roosevelt to easily win the 1912 United States presidential election, becoming the first Southerner to do so since 1848.
tgt_text: Wilson amaldagi respublikachi William Howard Taft va uchinchi partiya nomzodi Theodore Rooseveltni yengib, 1912-yilgi Amerika Qo‘shma Shtatlari prezidentlik saylovlarida osonlik bilan g‘alaba qozondi va 1848-yildan buyon buni amalga oshirgan birinchi janublik bo‘ldi.

src_text: His first major priority was the Revenue Act of 1913, which lowered tariffs and began the modern income tax.
tgt_text: Uning birinchi asosiy ustuvorligi 1913-yilgi Daromad toʻgʻrisidagi qonun boʻlib, u tariflarni pasaytirdi va zamonaviy daromad soligʻini boshladi.

src_text: Wilson also negotiated the passage of the Federal Reserve Act, which created the Federal Reserve System.
tgt_text: Wilson, shuningdek, Federal zaxira tizimini yaratgan Federal zahira toʻgʻrisidagi qonunni qabul qilish boʻyicha muzokaralar olib bordi.

src_text: At the outbreak of World War I in 1914, the U.S. declared neutrality as Wilson tried to negotiate a peace between the Allied and Central Powers.
tgt_text: 1914-yilda Birinchi jahon urushi boshlanganda, Wilson ittifoqchilar va markaziy kuchlar oʻrtasida tinchlik muzokaralarini olib borishga harakat qilganda, AQSh betarafligini eʼlon qildi.

src_text: Meanwhile, his policies alienated German and Irish Democrats and the Republicans won a landslide in the 1920 presidential election.
tgt_text: Shu bilan birga, uning siyosati nemis va irland demokratlarini uzoqlashtirdi va respublikachilar 1920-yilgi prezidentlik saylovlarida gʻalaba qozondi.

src_text: Thomas Woodrow Wilson was born to a family of Scots-Irish and Scottish descent in Staunton, Virginia.[1] He was the third of four children and the first son of Joseph Ruggles Wilson and Jessie Janet Woodrow.
tgt_text: Tomas Woodrow Wilson Virjiniya shtatining Staunton shahrida shotland-irland va shotland oilasida tugʻilgan.[1] U toʻrt farzandning uchinchisi va Jozef Ruggles Wilson va Jessi Janet Woodrowning birinchi oʻgʻli edi.

src_text: Wilson's paternal grandparents had immigrated to the United States from Strabane, County Tyrone, Ireland, in 1807, settling in Steubenville, Ohio.
tgt_text: Wilsonning ota-bobosi va buvisi 1807-yilda Irlandiyaning Tyrone okrugidagi Strabane shahridan Qoʻshma Shtatlarga koʻchib, Ogayo shtatining Steubenville shahrida joylashdilar.

src_text: Soon after the wedding, Joseph was ordained as a Presbyterian pastor and assigned to serve in Staunton.[4] Thomas was born in the Manse, a house of the Staunton First Presbyterian Church where Joseph served.
tgt_text: Toʻydan koʻp oʻtmay, Jozef Presviterian pastori etib tayinlangan va Stauntonda xizmat qilish uchun tayinlangan.[4] Tomas Jozef xizmat qilgan Staunton Birinchi Presviterian cherkovining Manse uyida tugʻilgan.

src_text: Before he was two, the family moved to Augusta, Georgia.[5]
tgt_text: U ikki yoshga toʻlmasdan oldin, oila Jorjiyaning Augusta shahriga koʻchib oʻtdi.

src_text: Wilson's family identified with the Southern United States and were staunch supporters of the Confederacy during the American Civil War.[7]
tgt_text: Wilsonning oilasi Amerika Qoʻshma Shtatlarining janubiy qismidan edilar va Amerika fuqarolik urushi davrida Konfederatsiyaning sodiq tarafdorlari edi.

src_text: Wilson's father was one of the founders of the Southern Presbyterian Church in the United States (PCUS) after it split from the Northern Presbyterians in 1861.
tgt_text: Wilsonning otasi 1861-yilda Shimoliy Presviterianlardan ajralib chiqqandan soʻng Amerika Qoʻshma Shtatlaridagi Janubiy Presviterian cherkovining (PCUS) asoschilaridan biri edi.

src_text: Carey Thomas, the dean, was an aggressive feminist and Wilson was in a bitter dispute with the president about his contract.

src_text: Carrier proteins can work with a concentration gradient (during passive transport), but some carrier proteins can move solutes against the concentration gradient (from low concentration to high concentration), with an input of energy.
tgt_text: Tashuvchi oqsillar konsentratsiya gradienti (passiv tashish paytida) bilan ishlashi mumkin, ammo ba'zi tashuvchi oqsillar energiya kiritish bilan erigan moddalarni konsentratsiya gradientiga (past konsentratsiyadan yuqori konsentratsiyaga) siljitishi mumkin.

src_text: In active transport, as carrier proteins are used to move materials against their concentration gradient, these proteins are known as pumps.
tgt_text: Faol transportda, tashuvchi oqsillar materiallarni kontsentratsion gradientiga qarshi harakat qilish uchun ishlatilganligi sababli, bu oqsillar nasoslar deb ataladi.

src_text: One way ATP powers active transport is by transferring a phosphate group directly to a carrier protein.
tgt_text: ATP faol transportni kuchaytirishning bir usuli fosfat guruhini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tashuvchi oqsilga o'tkazishdir.

src_text: This may cause the carrier protein to change its shape, which moves the molecule or ion to the other side of the membrane.
tgt_text: Bu tashuvchi oqsilning shaklini o'zgartirishiga olib kelishi mumkin, bu esa molekula yoki ionni membrananing boshqa tomoniga o'tkazadi.

src_text: An example of this type of active transport system, as shown in the figure below, is the sodium-potassium pump, which exchanges sodium ions for potassium ions across the plasma membrane of animal cells.
tgt_text: Jadvalda ko'rsatilgandek, bu turdagi faol transport tizimiga misol Rasm quyida, bu natriy-kaliyli nasos, natriy ionlarini hayvon hujayralarining plazma membranasi orqali kaliy ionlariga almashtiradi.

src_text: The sodium-potassium pump system moves sodium and potassium ions against large concentration gradients.
tgt_text: Natriy-kaliyli nasos tizimi natriy va kaliy ionlarini katta kontsentratsion gradientlarga qarshi harakatga keltiradi.

src_text: As is shown in the figure above, three sodium ions bind with the protein pump inside the cell.
tgt_text: da ko'rsatilganidek Rasm yuqorida uchta natriy ioni hujayra ichidagi oqsil pompasi bilan bog'lanadi.

src_text: At that point, two potassium ions from outside the cell bind to the protein pump.
tgt_text: O'sha paytda hujayra tashqarisidan ikkita kaliy ioni oqsil pompasiga bog'lanadi.

src_text: The potassium ions are then transported into the cell, and the process repeats.
tgt_text: Keyin kaliy ionlari hujayra ichiga tashiladi va jarayon takrorlanadi.

src_text: The sodium-potassium pump is found in the plasma membrane of almost every human cell and is common to all cellular life.
tgt_text: Natriy-kaliyli nasos deyarli har bir inson hujayrasining plazma membranasida joylashgan va barcha uyali hayot uchun umumiydir.

src_text: This results in a relatively negative charge on the inside of the membrane, and a positive charge on the outside.
tgt_text: Natijada membrananing ichki qismida nisbatan manfiy zaryad, tashqi tomondan esa musbat zaryad paydo bo'ladi.

src_text: Voltage is electrical potential energy that is caused by a separation of opposite charges, in this case across the membrane.
tgt_text: Kuchlanish - bu qarama-qarshi zaryadlarning ajralishi natijasida yuzaga keladigan elektr potentsial energiya, bu holda membrana bo'ylab.

src_text: Because the inside of the cell is negative compared to outside the cell, the membrane potential favors the movement of positively charged ions (cations) into the cell, and the movement of negative ions (anions) out of the cell.
tgt_text: Hujayraning ichki qismi hujayra tashqarisiga nisbatan manfiy bo'lgani uchun membrana potentsiali musbat zaryadlangan ionlarning (kationlarning) hujayra ichiga, manfiy ionlarning (anionlarning) hujayradan tashqariga harakatlanishiga yordam beradi.

src_text: Hess was born in Frauenfeld as the second of three children to Clemens Hess and Gertrud Hess (née Fischer).
tgt_text: Xess Frauenfeldda Klemens Xess va Gertrud Xessning (niyasi Fisher) uch farzandining ikkinchisi boʻlib tugʻilgan.

src_text: His primary interests were the regulation of blood flow and respiration.
tgt_text: Uning asosiy qiziqishlari qon oqimi va nafas olishni tartibga solish edi.

src_text: In the 1930s, he began mapping the parts of the diencephalon that control the internal organs using cats.[5] This research won him the Nobel prize in Physiology and Medicine 1949.
tgt_text: 1930-yillarda u mushuklar yordamida ichki organlarni boshqaradigan diensefalon qismlarini xaritaga tushirishni boshladi.[3] Ushbu tadqiqot unga 1949-yilda fiziologiya va tibbiyot boʻyicha Nobel mukofotiga sazovor boʻldi.

src_text: Hess used brain stimulation techniques developed in the late 1920s.
tgt_text: Hess 1920-yillarning oxirida ishlab chiqilgan miya stimulyatsiyasi usullaridan foydalangan.

src_text: This allowed him to map regions of the brain to specific physiological responses.
tgt_text: Bu unga miyaning hududlarini oʻziga xos fiziologik javoblarga xaritalash imkonini berdi.

src_text: By stimulating the hypothalamus, he could induce behaviors from excitement to apathy; depending on the region of stimulation.
tgt_text: Gipotalamusni ragʻbatlantirish orqali u hayajondan apatiyaga qadar xatti-harakatlarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin; ragʻbatlantirish mintaqasiga qarab.

src_text: He found that he could induce different responses when stimulating the anterior (lateral) hypothalamus compared to stimulating the posterior ventromedial hypothalamus.
tgt_text: U posterior ventromedial gipotalamusni stimulyatsiya qilish bilan solishtirganda oldingi (lateral) gipotalamusni qoʻzgʻatishda turli xil javoblarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkinligini aniqladi.

src_text: Hess also found that he could induce sleep in cats – a finding that was highly controversial at the time but later confirmed by other researchers, including his son Rudolf Max Hess.[4]
tgt_text: Xess shuningdek, mushuklarda uyquga olib kelishi mumkinligini aniqladi - bu oʻsha paytda juda ziddiyatli boʻlgan, ammo keyinchalik boshqa tadqiqotchilar, jumladan, uning oʻgʻli Rudolf Maks Xess tomonidan tasdiqlangan.

src_text: - Nobel prize in Physiology and Medicine (1949)[4]
tgt_text: - Fiziologiya va tibbiyot boʻyicha Nobel mukofoti (1949)

src_text: - Hyaline cartilage forms the skeleton of the embryo before it is transformed into bone; it is found in the adult body at the tip of the nose and around the ends of the long bones, where it prevents friction at the joints.

src_text: When a connective tissue has a high concentration of cells or fibers, it has a proportionally-less-dense matrix.

src_text: Collagen fibers provide strength to the tissue, preventing it from being torn or separated from the surrounding tissues.

src_text: Elastic fibers are made of the protein elastin; this fiber can stretch to one and one half of its length, returning to its original size and shape.

src_text: Loose connective tissue, also called areolar connective tissue, has a sampling of all of the components of a connective tissue.

src_text: Loose connective tissue has some fibroblasts, although macrophages are present as well.
tgt_text: Bo'shashgan biriktiruvchi to'qima ba'zi fibroblastlarga ega, garchi makrofaglar ham mavjud.

src_text: The material in the connective tissue gives it a loose consistency similar to a cotton ball that has been pulled apart.

src_text: Loose connective tissue is found around every blood vessel, helping to keep the vessel in place.

src_text: - Explain the functions of connective tissues
tgt_text: - Birlashtiruvchi to'qimalarning vazifalarini tushuntiring

src_text: As may be obvious from its name, one of the major functions of connective tissue is to connect tissues and organs.
tgt_text: Nomidan ko'rinib turibdiki, biriktiruvchi to'qimaning asosiy vazifalaridan biri to'qimalar va organlarni bog'lashdir.

src_text: The matrix usually includes a large amount of extracellular material produced by the connective tissue cells that are embedded within it.
tgt_text: Matritsa odatda biriktiruvchi to'qima hujayralari tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan ko'p miqdordagi hujayradan tashqari materialni o'z ichiga oladi.

src_text: The matrix plays a major role in the functioning of this tissue.
tgt_text: Ushbu to'qimalarning ishlashida matritsa katta rol o'ynaydi.

src_text: This ground substance is usually a fluid, but it can also be mineralized and solid, as in bones.
tgt_text: Bu tuproq moddasi odatda suyuqlikdir, lekin u suyaklarda bo'lgani kabi mineralizatsiyalangan va qattiq bo'lishi ham mumkin.

src_text: Protection is another major function of connective tissue, in the form of fibrous capsules and bones that protect delicate organs and, of course, the skeletal system.
tgt_text: Himoya - biriktiruvchi to'qimaning yana bir asosiy vazifasi, nozik organlarni va, albatta, suyak tizimini himoya qiladigan tolali kapsulalar va suyaklar shaklida.

src_text: Specialized cells in connective tissue defend the body from microorganisms that enter the body.
tgt_text: Birlashtiruvchi to'qimadagi maxsus hujayralar tanani tanaga kiradigan mikroorganizmlardan himoya qiladi.

src_text: Adipose cells store surplus energy in the form of fat and contribute to the thermal insulation of the body.
tgt_text: Yog 'hujayralari ortiqcha energiyani yog' shaklida saqlaydi va tananing issiqlik izolatsiyasiga hissa qo'shadi.

src_text: All connective tissues derive from the mesodermal layer of the embryo (see [link] ).
tgt_text: Barcha biriktiruvchi to'qimalar embrionning mezodermal qatlamidan kelib chiqadi (qarang: [havola]).

src_text: In bone, the matrix is rigid and described as calcified because of the deposited calcium salts.
tgt_text: Suyakda matritsa qattiq va kaltsiy tuzlari to'planganligi sababli kalsifikatsiyalangan deb ta'riflanadi.

src_text: In fluid connective tissue , in other words, lymph and blood, various specialized cells circulate in a watery fluid containing salts, nutrients, and dissolved proteins.
tgt_text: Suyuq biriktiruvchi to'qimada, boshqacha aytganda, limfa va qonda turli xil maxsus hujayralar tuzlar, ozuqa moddalari va erigan oqsillarni o'z ichiga olgan suvli suyuqlikda aylanadi.

src_text: Fibrocytes, adipocytes, and mesenchymal cells are fixed cells, which means they remain within the connective tissue.
tgt_text: Fibrositlar, adipotsitlar va mezenximal hujayralar sobit hujayralardir, ya'ni ular biriktiruvchi to'qima ichida qoladi.

src_text: Other cells move in and out of the connective tissue in response to chemical signals.
tgt_text: Boshqa hujayralar kimyoviy signallarga javoban biriktiruvchi to'qima ichida va tashqarisida harakatlanadi.

src_text: Macrophages, mast cells, lymphocytes, plasma cells, and phagocytic cells are found in connective tissue proper but are actually part of the immune system protecting the body.
tgt_text: Makrofaglar, mast hujayralari, limfotsitlar, plazma hujayralari va fagotsitar hujayralar to'g'ri biriktiruvchi to'qimada joylashgan, ammo aslida tanani himoya qiluvchi immunitet tizimining bir qismidir.

src_text: The number and type of adipocytes depends on the tissue and location, and vary among individuals in the population.
tgt_text: Adipotsitlarning soni va turi to'qima va joylashuvga bog'liq bo'lib, populyatsiyadagi shaxslar orasida farq qiladi.

src_text: Cytokines recruit other cells of the immune system to infected sites and stimulate their activities.
tgt_text: Sitokinlar immunitet tizimining boshqa hujayralarini zararlangan joylarga jalb qiladi va ularning faoliyatini rag'batlantiradi.

src_text: In contrast, fixed macrophages are permanent residents of their tissues.

src_text: In a new study published in Nature Plants, researchers at Nagoya University, Japan, have identified a plant enzyme that is key to activating a nitrate uptake mechanism in response to nitrogen starvation.
tgt_text: Da chop etilgan yangi tadqiqotda Tabiat o'simliklari, Yaponiyaning Nagoya universiteti tadqiqotchilari azot ochligiga javoban nitrat olish mexanizmini faollashtirish uchun kalit bo'lgan o'simlik fermentini aniqladilar.

src_text: This finding explains how plants meet their needs in challenging environments, opening doors to improving agriculture in such environments.
tgt_text: Ushbu topilma o'simliklar qiyin sharoitlarda o'z ehtiyojlarini qanday qondirishini tushuntiradi va bunday muhitda qishloq xo'jaligini yaxshilash uchun eshiklarni ochadi.

src_text: Interestingly, when Arabidopsis plants synthesize the NRT2.1 protein, they initially produce an inactive protein that can later be activated when the high-affinity transport system is needed.
tgt_text: Qizig'i shundaki, qachon Arabidopsis o'simliklar NRT2.1 oqsilini sintez qiladi, ular dastlab faol bo'lmagan oqsilni ishlab chiqaradi, keyinchalik yuqori afiniteli transport tizimi kerak bo'lganda faollashishi mumkin.

src_text: In other words, plants need to synthesize the proteins in a high-affinity transport system before a nitrogen deficiency necessitates the use of those proteins, because nitrogen deficiency itself makes it difficult to synthesize new proteins.
tgt_text: Boshqacha qilib aytadigan bo'lsak, azot tanqisligi ushbu oqsillardan foydalanishni talab qilishidan oldin o'simliklar yuqori afinitetli transport tizimidagi oqsillarni sintez qilishi kerak, chunki azot etishmasligining o'zi yangi oqsillarni sintez qilishni qiyinlashtiradi.

src_text: In order to better understand this remarkable system, Dr. Matsubayashi and his colleagues set out to identify the protein that activates NRT2.1 in response to nitrogen starvation.
tgt_text: Ushbu ajoyib tizimni yaxshiroq tushunish uchun doktor Matsubayashi va uning hamkasblari azot ochligiga javoban NRT2.1 ni faollashtiradigan oqsilni aniqlashga kirishdilar.

src_text: Their experiments soon drew their attention to a protein called At4g32950.
tgt_text: Tez orada ularning tajribalari e'tiborini At4g32950 nomli oqsilga qaratdi.

src_text: It achieves this activation by removing a phosphate group from a specific location on the NRT2.1 protein, so the investigators decided to give the At4g32950 protein a new name: CEPD-induced phosphatase, or "CEPH" for short.
tgt_text: Bu faollikka NRT2.1 oqsilining ma'lum bir joyidan fosfat guruhini olib tashlash orqali erishadi, shuning uchun tergovchilar At4g32950 oqsiliga yangi nom berishga qaror qilishdi: CEPD-induktsiyali fosfataza yoki qisqacha "CEPH".

src_text: Collectively, these results indicate that CEPH plays a critical role in responding to nitrogen starvation through its activation of the NRT2.1 protein.
tgt_text: Umuman olganda, bu natijalar shuni ko'rsatadiki, CEPH azot ochligiga NRT2.1 oqsilini faollashtirish orqali javob berishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynaydi.

src_text: Dr. Matsubayashi sees considerable potential utility in CEPH as a genetic engineering tool, as he notes, "Artificially enhancing CEPH activity could enable scientists to create plants that grow even in soils with low nutrient levels."
tgt_text: Doktor Matsubayashi CEPHda katta potentsial foydani genetik muhandislik vositasi sifatida ko'radi, chunki u ta'kidlaganidek, "CEPH faolligini sun'iy ravishda oshirish olimlarga hatto ozuqa moddalari past bo'lgan tuproqlarda ham o'sadigan o'simliklarni yaratishga imkon beradi".

src_text: Such findings could change the way agriculture and food security are handled.
tgt_text: Bunday xulosalar qishloq xo'jaligi va oziq -ovqat xavfsizligini boshqarish usulini o'zgartirishi mumkin.

src_text: Historically, stars have been important to civilizations throughout the world.

src_text: To explain why these stars exerted no net gravitational pull on the Solar System, Isaac Newton suggested that the stars were equally distributed in every direction, an idea prompted by the theologian Richard Bentley.[27]
tgt_text: Nega bu yulduzlar Quyosh tizimiga sezilarli gravitatsiyaviy taʼsir etmasligini izohlash uchun Isaac Newton yulduzlar barcha yoʻnalishda teng tarqalgan, deb taxmin qilgan, bu taxminni teolog Richard Bentley maʼqullagan.[26]

src_text: The science of stellar spectroscopy was pioneered by Joseph von Fraunhofer and Angelo Secchi.
tgt_text: Yulduz spektroskopiyasi faniga Joseph von Fraunhofer va Angelo Secchi asos solishgan.

src_text: The first solution to the problem of deriving an orbit of binary stars from telescope observations was made by Felix Savary in 1827.[30] The twentieth century saw increasingly rapid advances in the scientific study of stars.
tgt_text: Qoʻshaloq yulduzlar orbitasini teleskop kuzatuvlaridan chiqarish muammosini birinchi boʻlib Felix Savary 1827-yili hal qildi.[29] Yigirmanchi asrda yulduzlarni ilmiy oʻrganish keskin rivojlandi.

src_text: Circa 1600, the names of the constellations were used to name the stars in the corresponding regions of the sky.
tgt_text: 1600-yillarda yulduz turkumlari nomlari osmonning tegishli hududlaridagi yulduzlarni nomlashda ishlatildi.

src_text: The German astronomer Johann Bayer created a series of star maps and applied Greek letters as designations to the stars in each constellation.
tgt_text: Olmon astronomi Johann Bayer qator yulduz xaritalarini yaratib, har bir yulduz turkumidagi yulduzlarni belgilash uchun yunon harflarini ishlatdi.

src_text: The period of gravitational contraction lasts about 10 to 15 million years.

src_text: As a giant, the Sun will lose roughly 30% of its current mass.[63][71]

src_text: The nearest star to the Earth, apart from the Sun, is Proxima Centauri, which is 39.9 trillion kilometres, or 4.2 light-years away.
tgt_text: Yerga Quyoshdan keyin eng yaqin yulduz Proxima Centauri boʻlib, u 39,9 trillion km yoki 4,2 yorugʻlik yili uzoqlikdadir.

src_text: Most stars are between 1 billion and 10 billion years old.
tgt_text: Aksariyat yulduzlar 1-10 milliard yoshda.

src_text: The Sun is also a star, but it is close enough to the Earth to appear as a disk instead, and to provide daylight.
tgt_text: Quyosh ham yulduz, biroq u Yerga disk boʻlib koʻrinish va kun yorugʻini berish uchun yetarlicha yaqindir.

src_text: Betelgeuse, however, has a much lower density than the Sun.[97]
tgt_text: Biroq Betelgeyzening zichligi Quyoshnikidan ancha past.[93]

src_text: The motion of a star relative to the Sun can provide useful information about the origin and age of a star, as well as the structure and evolution of the surrounding galaxy.
tgt_text: Yulduzning Quyoshga nisbatan harakati yulduz kelib chiqishi va yoshi, shuningdek uning atrofidagi galaktika tuzilishi va evolutsiyasi haqida foydali maʼlumot berishi mumkin.

src_text: Once both rates of movement are known, the space velocity of the star relative to the Sun or the galaxy can be computed.
tgt_text: Harakatining ikkala qiymatlari aniqlangach, yulduzning Quyoshga yoki galaktikaga nisbatan fazoviy tezligi hisoblanishi mumkin boʻladi.

src_text: As of 2006, the star with the highest known absolute magnitude is LBV 1806-20, with a magnitude of −14.2.
tgt_text: 2006-yilga koʻra eng katta absolut yulduz kattaligiga ega yulduz LBV 1806-20 boʻlib, magnitudasi −14,2 ga teng.

src_text: This star is at least 5,000,000 times more luminous than the Sun.[131] The least luminous stars that are currently known are located in the NGC 6397 cluster.

src_text: The most common of these are types L and T, which classify the coldest low-mass stars and brown dwarfs.
