src_text: But, according to the Wobble Hypothesis, the base on the third position of the codon and that on the anticodon need not be complementary (which helps explain why there are very few types of tRNA molecules, inspite of there being 61 codons).
tgt_text: Ammo, Wobble gipotezasiga ko'ra, kodonning uchinchi pozitsiyasi va antikodondagi asos bir-birini to'ldiruvchi bo'lishi shart emas (bu 61 ta kodon bo'lishiga qaramay, nima uchun tRNK molekulalarining juda oz turlari mavjudligini tushuntirishga yordam beradi).

src_text: There are some justifications for why it should exist and that is why it is still called a hypothesis.
tgt_text: Nima uchun mavjud bo'lishi kerakligi haqida ba'zi asoslar mavjud va shuning uchun u hali ham gipoteza deb ataladi.

src_text: And this statement is not true:"the base on the third position of the codon and that on the anticodon need not be complementary".
tgt_text: Va bu bayonot to'g'ri emas: "kodonning uchinchi pozitsiyasidagi va antikodondagi asos bir-birini to'ldiruvchi bo'lishi shart emas".

src_text: So the statement of wobble hypothesis is that the first base of the anticodon (often is a modified/atypical nucleobase) can show promiscuity of binding.
tgt_text: Shunday qilib, tebranish gipotezasi shundan iboratki, antikodonning birinchi bazasi (ko'pincha o'zgartirilgan/atipik nukleobazalar) bog'lanishning nopokligini ko'rsatishi mumkin.

src_text: The Wobble Hypothesis - as stated above - has been unequivocally shown to be correct.
tgt_text: The Wobble Gipoteza - yuqorida aytib o'tilganidek - to'g'ri ekanligi aniq ko'rsatilgan.

src_text: Thus, the prediction that the 5'-tRNA anticodon bases, G and I could wobble (and C could not) have been borne out.
tgt_text: Shunday qilib, 5'-tRNK antikodon asoslari, G va men chayqalishi mumkin (va C bo'lishi mumkin emas) degan bashorat amalga oshdi.

src_text: The point to remember is that there is a scientific rationale for this in terms of the three-dimensional structure of the anticodon in the tRNA (which holds the first two bases in position by base stacking) and the proximity of the potentially hydrogen-bonding groups in the various bases.
tgt_text: Esda tutish kerak bo'lgan narsa shundaki, buning uchun tRNKdagi antikodonning uch o'lchovli tuzilishi (birinchi ikkita bazani asosiy stacking orqali ushlab turadi) va potentsial vodorod bog'lovchi guruhlarning yaqinligi nuqtai nazaridan ilmiy asos bor. turli asoslarda.

src_text: G pairing with C or U always works, whereas I pairing with A, C or G will work with amino acids encoded by all four bases in a block (e.g. Leu, Val, Ser), but not where there are blocks of two (e.g. Tyr, His, Asn).
tgt_text: C yoki U bilan G juftligi har doim ishlaydi, I, A, C yoki G bilan bog‘lash esa blokdagi barcha to‘rtta asos (masalan, Leu, Val, Ser) tomonidan kodlangan aminokislotalar bilan ishlaydi, lekin ikkita blok mavjud bo‘lganda emas (masalan, Tyr, His, Asn).

src_text: One final point that emphasizes the chemical basis of all this.
tgt_text: Bularning barchasining kimyoviy asosini ta'kidlaydigan yakuniy nuqta.

src_text: By the end of this section, you will be able to:
tgt_text: Ushbu bo'lim oxirida siz quyidagilarni amalga oshirishingiz mumkin:

src_text: It is the variety of amino acid side chains that gives rise to the incredible variation of protein structure and function.
tgt_text: Bu protein tuzilishi va funktsiyasining ajoyib o'zgarishiga olib keladigan aminokislotalar yon zanjirlarining xilma-xilligi.

src_text: Further investigation proved the existence of a triplet code as described in the table below.
tgt_text: Keyingi tekshiruvlar quyidagi jadvalda tavsiflanganidek, uchlik kodning mavjudligini isbotladi.

src_text: With so many combinations and only 20 amino acids, what does the cell do with the other possibilities?
tgt_text: Juda ko'p birikmalar va atigi 20 ta aminokislotalar bilan hujayra boshqa imkoniyatlar bilan nima qiladi?

src_text: The three stop codons also have colloquial names: UAA (ochre), UAG (amber), UGA (opal), with UAA being the most common in prokaryotic genes.
tgt_text: Uchta to'xtash kodonlari ham so'zlashuv nomlariga ega: UAA (oxra), UAG (qahrabo), UGA (opal), UAA prokaryotik genlarda eng keng tarqalgan.

src_text: The stop codons are sometimes also used to encode what are now considered the 21 st and 22 nd amino acids, selenocysteine (UGA) and pyrrolysine (UAG).
tgt_text: To'xtash kodonlari ba'zan hozirda 21 va 22-chi aminokislotalar, selenosistein (UGA) va pirrolizin (UAG) deb hisoblangan narsalarni kodlash uchun ham ishlatiladi.

src_text: These amino acids have been discovered to be consistently encoded in some species of prokarya and archaea.
tgt_text: Ushbu aminokislotalar prokarya va arxeyaning ba'zi turlarida doimiy ravishda kodlanganligi aniqlangan.

src_text: Note that there are no dedicated start codons: instead, AUG codes for both methionine and the start of translation, depending on the circumstance, as explained forthwith.
tgt_text: E'tibor bering, maxsus boshlang'ich kodonlar mavjud emas: buning o'rniga, vaziyatga qarab metionin va tarjima boshlanishi uchun AUG kodlari, darhol tushuntirilgan.

src_text: Other minor alterations to the genetic code exist as well, but the universality of the code in general remains.
tgt_text: Genetik kodda boshqa kichik o'zgarishlar ham mavjud, ammo kodning universalligi saqlanib qolmoqda.

src_text: Many of these changes have been cataloged by the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) based on work by Jukes and Osawa at the University of California at Berkeley (USA) and the University of Nagoya (Japan), respectively.
tgt_text: Ushbu o'zgarishlarning ko'pchiligi Milliy Biotexnologiya Axborot Markazi (NCBI) tomonidan mos ravishda Berklidagi Kaliforniya universiteti (AQSh) va Nagoya (Yaponiya) universitetida Jukes va Osava ishlariga asoslangan holda kataloglangan.

src_text: Despite these limitations, ESCs have been proven to be powerful tools in our current understanding of differentiation pathways.
tgt_text: Ushbu cheklovlarga qaramay, ESClar differentsiatsiya yo'llari haqidagi hozirgi tushunchamizda kuchli vosita ekanligi isbotlangan.

src_text: Finally, cocktails or individual factors are presented to cells grown in a variety of conditions to test their neural inducing activities.
tgt_text: Nihoyat, kokteyllar yoki individual omillar turli sharoitlarda o'stirilgan hujayralarga ularning nervlarni qo'zg'atuvchi faoliyatini sinab ko'rish uchun taqdim etiladi.

src_text: Redundancy seems to be widespread in genomes of higher organisms.
tgt_text: Yuqori organizmlar genomlarida ortiqchalik keng tarqalgan ko'rinadi.

src_text: Examples of apparently redundant genes come from numerous studies of developmental biology, immunology, neurobiology and the cell cycle.
tgt_text: Ko'rinib turibdiki, ortiqcha genlarga misollar rivojlanish biologiyasi, immunologiya, neyrobiologiya va hujayra siklining ko'plab tadqiqotlaridan olingan.

src_text: Yet there is a problem: genes encoding functional proteins must be under selection pressure.
tgt_text: Shunga qaramay, muammo bor: funktsional oqsillarni kodlaydigan genlar tanlov bosimi ostida bo'lishi kerak.

src_text: We present four cases that can explain why genetic redundancy is common.
tgt_text: Biz genetik ortiqchalik nima uchun keng tarqalganligini tushuntira oladigan to'rtta holatni taqdim etamiz.

src_text: In three cases, redundancy is even evolutionarily stable.
tgt_text: Uchta holatda ortiqchalik hatto evolyutsion jihatdan barqarordir.

src_text: Selection is described by x′i = fixi/f, where f = Eixifi denotes the average fitness of the population.
tgt_text: Tanlov tomonidan tavsiflanadi x′i = fixi/f, qayerda f = Sixifi aholining o'rtacha jismoniy tayyorgarligini bildiradi.

src_text: The fitness of a particular genotype is given by the efficacy of the most efficient gene.
tgt_text: Muayyan genotipning yaroqliligi eng samarali genning samaradorligi bilan ta'minlanadi.

src_text: For a large number of genes, however, the conditions on efficacies and mutation rates become very restrictive.
tgt_text: Biroq, ko'p sonli genlar uchun samaradorlik va mutatsiya stavkalari bo'yicha shartlar juda cheklangan bo'ladi.

src_text: Mutations in B can either lead to variant b1, which has lost the ability to perform function F1 but still performs F2, or to variant b2, which is completely inactive mutation rates are ub1 and ub2, respectively.
tgt_text: Mutatsiyalar B variantga olib kelishi mumkin b1, funktsiyani bajarish qobiliyatini yo'qotgan F1 lekin baribir ijro etadi F2, yoki variantga b2, bu mutlaqo faol bo'lmagan mutatsiya stavkalari ub1 va ub2, mos ravishda.

src_text: Our results for haploid models also apply to diploid models.
tgt_text: Gaploid modellar bo'yicha natijalarimiz diploid modellarga ham tegishli.

src_text: Diploid models with developmental errors also give stable redundancy.
tgt_text: Rivojlanish xatolari bo'lgan diploid modellar ham barqaror ortiqchalikni beradi.

src_text: One such case was discovered by Brookfield: it assumes that the double heterozygote, AB/ab, is as fit as the wild type, AB/AB, but Ab/ab, aB/ab and ab/ab have low fitness 1 .
tgt_text: Bunday holatlardan biri Brukfild tomonidan kashf etilgan: u qo'sh geterozigota deb taxmin qiladi, AB/ab, yovvoyi tur kabi mos keladi, AB/AB, lekin Ab/ab, aB/ab va ab/ab 1 .

src_text: This can be the consequence of rare developmental errors.
tgt_text: Bu kamdan-kam rivojlanish xatolarining natijasi bo'lishi mumkin.

src_text: Several such examples have been discussed previously 5 .
tgt_text: Bir qancha bunday misollar avvalroq muhokama qilingan 5 .

src_text: For example the ribosome tunnel acts as a tube that can handle extended conformations and secondary structures of the peptide chain.
tgt_text: Masalan, ribosoma tunneli kengaytirilgan konformatsiyalar va peptid zanjirining ikkilamchi tuzilmalarini boshqara oladigan naycha vazifasini bajaradi.

src_text: Charge specific residues of nascent peptides slow down or stop the translation process (Kramer et al., 2009).
tgt_text: Yangi paydo bo'lgan peptidlarning o'ziga xos qoldiqlari tarjima jarayonini sekinlashtiradi yoki to'xtatadi (Kramer va boshq., 2009).

src_text: Ribosomes transmit signals relating the nascent chain and its position in the tunnel to their surface, thereby controlling the interactions with SRP (Walter and Blobel, 1983 Kramer et al., 2009).
tgt_text: Ribosomalar yangi paydo bo'lgan zanjir va uning tunneldagi holati bilan bog'liq signallarni ularning yuzasiga uzatadi va shu bilan SRP bilan o'zaro ta'sirni nazorat qiladi (Walter and Blobel, 1983 Kramer va boshq., 2009).

src_text: The binding of SRP to the nascent protein in eukaryotes can stop the translation process (Kramer et al., 2009).
tgt_text: SRP ning eukaryotlarda paydo bo'lgan oqsil bilan bog'lanishi tarjima jarayonini to'xtatishi mumkin (Kramer va boshq., 2009).

src_text: Trigger factor interaction with the ribosome and nascent chain is a function of their length, sequence and folding status (Kaiser et al., 2006 Raine et al., 2006).
tgt_text: Ribosoma va yangi paydo bo'lgan zanjir bilan tetik omilining o'zaro ta'siri ularning uzunligi, ketma-ketligi va katlama holatiga bog'liq (Kaiser va boshq., 2006 Raine va boshq., 2006).

src_text: By reducing the rate of folding in vitro and in vivo, trigger factors have been shown to improve the folding of model multi-domain substrates (Agashe et al., 2004).
tgt_text: Katlama tezligini kamaytirish orqali in vitro va in vivo, tetik omillari model ko'p domenli substratlarning katlanmasını yaxshilash uchun ko'rsatildi (Agashe va boshq., 2004).

src_text: Eukaryotes use factors such as J, Hsp70, Hsp 40 and nascent chain associated complex (NAC) protein-based systems along with other such mechanisms.
tgt_text: Eukaryotlar J, Hsp70, Hsp 40 kabi omillar va boshqa mexanizmlar bilan bir qatorda yangi paydo bo'lgan zanjir bilan bog'liq kompleks (NAC) oqsilga asoslangan tizimlardan foydalanadi.

src_text: Pausing allows cells to adapt to changing environmental conditions such as heat stress.
tgt_text: To'xtatib turish hujayralarga issiqlik stressi kabi o'zgaruvchan muhit sharoitlariga moslashish imkonini beradi.

src_text: But, these factors also adversely reduce the activity of those proteins (Crombie et al., 1992 Komar et al., 1999).
tgt_text: Ammo, bu omillar, shuningdek, ushbu oqsillarning faolligini yomonlashtiradi (Crombie va boshq., 1992 Komar va boshq., 1999).

src_text: The pause sites occur within the CRD c-myc region and map to rare arginine (CGA) and adjacent threonine (ACA) codons (Lemm and Ross, 2002).
tgt_text: Pauza joylari CRD c-myc mintaqasida joylashgan va noyob arginin (CGA) va qo'shni treonin (ACA) kodonlari bilan taqqoslanadi (Lemm va Ross, 2002).

src_text: Data from Lemm (Lemm and Ross, 2002) shows that pause sites also occur at different codons within the CRD.
tgt_text: Lemm ma'lumotlari (Lemm va Ross, 2002) pauza joylari CRD ichidagi turli kodonlarda ham paydo bo'lishini ko'rsatadi.

src_text: This supports the claim that the CGA and ACA codons are a pause site (Lemm and Ross, 2002), since CGA and ACA produce a pause, while replacing them with synonymous codons produced no pausing effect.
tgt_text: Bu CGA va ACA kodonlari pauza joyi ekanligi haqidagi da'voni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi (Lemm va Ross, 2002), chunki CGA va ACA pauza hosil qiladi, ularni sinonimik kodonlar bilan almashtirish esa pauza ta'sirini yaratmaydi.

src_text: The SD sequence is generally upstream of the start codon AUG (Shine and Dalgarno, 1975).
tgt_text: SD ketma-ketligi odatda AUG boshlang'ich kodonining yuqori oqimida joylashgan (Shine va Dalgarno, 1975).

src_text: TP has been studied in very few non-bacterial species thus far.
tgt_text: TP hozirgacha juda oz sonli bakterial bo'lmagan turlarda o'rganilgan.

src_text: A common thread exists between the mechanical execution of the folding process (exit tunnel/factors/chaperones) to internal mRNA processes involved in folding of the nascent protein.
tgt_text: Buklanish jarayonining mexanik bajarilishi (chiqish tunnel/faktorlar/kaperonlar) va yangi paydo bo'lgan oqsilning katlanishida ishtirok etuvchi ichki mRNK jarayonlari o'rtasida umumiy bog'liqlik mavjud.

src_text: This collection of Canva alternatives is created specifically for those who are looking for online, mobile or free software to design, share and print business cards, logos, presentations, and other templates.
tgt_text: Ushbu Canva alternativlari to'plami, tashrif kartalari, logotiplar, taqdimotlar va boshqa shablonlarni loyihalash, almashish va chop etish uchun onlayn, mobil yoki bepul dasturiy ta'minot qidiruvchilar uchun maxsus yaratilgan.

src_text: If you don’t like the Canva’s interface or need more features, install and use one of these programs for creating graphic design without special skills.
tgt_text: Agar sizga Canva interfeysi yoqmasa yoki qo'shimcha funktsiyalar kerak bo'lsa, maxsus ko'nikmalarsiz grafik dizayn yaratish uchun ushbu dasturlardan birini o'rnating va foydalaning.

src_text: Canva is an online service that allows users to do web design even without drawing skills.
tgt_text: Canva bu foydalanuvchilarga rasm chizish qobiliyatisiz ham veb-dizaynini amalga oshirishga imkon beradigan onlayn xizmatdir.

src_text: However, if you don’t like Canva because of its price or if you want to try other programs, here you will find 10 efficient Canva alternatives for any user.
tgt_text: Ammo, agar siz Canva-ni narxiga qarab yoqtirmasangiz yoki boshqa dasturlarni sinab ko'rmoqchi bo'lsangiz, bu erda har qanday foydalanuvchi uchun 10 ta samarali Canva alternativasini topasiz.

src_text: RelayThat is a fast design tool that you can use to create photos for social networks and advertising.
tgt_text: RelayThat ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va reklama uchun fotosuratlar yaratish uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan tezkor dizayn vositasidir.

src_text: Main RelayThat Features:
tgt_text: Asosiy RelayThat xususiyatlari:

src_text: RelayThat is a simple to use tool that provides templates for all main social networks (including AdSense), over 2000 Smart Layouts and 350,000 free photos.
tgt_text: RelayThat - bu barcha asosiy ijtimoiy tarmoqlar (shu jumladan AdSense), 2000 dan ziyod Smart Layouts va 350,000 bepul fotosuratlar uchun shablonlarni taqdim etadigan oddiy vosita.

src_text: It’s a great Canva alternative, which offers complex image editing tools and the possibility to preplan your future Instagram posts.
tgt_text: Bu murakkab tasvirni tahrirlash vositalari va kelajakdagi Instagram postlaringizni oldindan rejalashtirish imkoniyatini taklif qiluvchi ajoyib Canva alternativasi.

src_text: With RelayThat, you will be able to create top-level photos for various networks without effort.
tgt_text: RelayThat yordamida siz turli tarmoqlar uchun yuqori darajadagi fotosuratlarni kuch sarflamasdan yaratishingiz mumkin bo'ladi.

src_text: You can use it for free by creating an account.
tgt_text: Hisob qaydnomasini yaratish orqali uni bepul ishlatishingiz mumkin.

src_text: However, you should take into consideration that your photos will have RelayThat watermarks.
tgt_text: Shunga qaramay, siz fotosuratlaringizda RelayThat suv belgilariga ega bo'lishini hisobga olishingiz kerak.

src_text: PicMonkey is the company that once developed the Picnik graphics editor bought by Google in 2010.
tgt_text: PicMonkey - bu bir vaqtlar Google tomonidan 2010 yilda sotib olingan Picnik grafik muharririni ishlab chiqqan kompaniya.

src_text: Today, PicMonkey offers users a SaaS solution, which means that you won’t have to install anything.
tgt_text: Bugungi kunda PicMonkey foydalanuvchilarga SaaS echimini taklif qilmoqda, ya'ni siz hech narsa o'rnatishingizga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

src_text: The service works according to the freemium model, which means that some basic features are available for free.
tgt_text: Xizmat freemium modeliga muvofiq ishlaydi, ya'ni ba'zi bir asosiy xususiyatlar bepul mavjud.

src_text: But for some advanced tools, you will have to pay (from $33 per year).
tgt_text: Ammo ba'zi bir rivojlangan vositalar uchun siz to'lashingiz kerak bo'ladi (yiliga 33 dollardan).

src_text: In free mode, PicMonkey allows you to set frames for your shots, apply effects and filters to them, and create captions using various fonts.
tgt_text: Bepul rejimda PicMonkey sizning kadrlaringiz uchun freymlarni o'rnatishga, ularga effektlar va filtrlarni qo'llashga va turli shriftlardan foydalanib taglavhalarni yaratishga imkon beradi.

src_text: Visme is a cloud-based platform for creating visual content, with which you can quickly design presentations, infographics and banners.
tgt_text: Visme - bu vizual tarkib yaratish uchun bulutga asoslangan platforma bo'lib, uning yordamida taqdimotlarni, infografikani va bannerlarni tezda loyihalashtirishingiz mumkin.

src_text: It offers thousands of pre-made templates, images, icons, over 50 charts and maps as well as audio and video clips.
tgt_text: Unda oldindan tayyorlangan minglab shablonlar, rasmlar, ikonkalar, 50 dan ortiq grafikalar va xaritalar hamda audio va videokliplar taqdim etiladi.

src_text: Moreover, a recipient can view them on a desktop or mobile device, and you can get analytics and visitor metrics on your projects.
tgt_text: Bundan tashqari, qabul qiluvchi ularni ish stolida yoki mobil qurilmada ko'rishi mumkin va siz o'zingizning loyihalaringiz bo'yicha tahlil va tashrif buyuruvchilar ko'rsatkichlarini olishingiz mumkin.

src_text: Also, there are animated characters that you can add to your project in one click.
tgt_text: Bundan tashqari, bir marta bosish orqali o'zingizning loyihangizga qo'shishingiz mumkin bo'lgan animatsion belgilar mavjud.

src_text: Stencil is a cloud-based graphics tool that allows its user to create and share visual content very fast.
tgt_text: Stencil - bu bulutga asoslangan grafik vosita bo'lib, uning foydalanuvchisi vizual tarkibni juda tez yaratishi va almashishi mumkin.

src_text: It’s one of the best Canva alternatives as it offers a lot of features and allows both professionals and beginners to create graphics for websites, blogs, and social networks.
tgt_text: Bu eng yaxshi Canva alternativalaridan biridir, chunki u juda ko'p funktsiyalarni taklif qiladi va professionallarga ham, yangi boshlanuvchilarga ham veb-saytlar, bloglar va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uchun grafikalar yaratishga imkon beradi.

src_text: It allows you to visualize information for reports, presentations, articles, and posts.
tgt_text: Bu sizga ma'ruzalar, taqdimotlar, maqolalar va postlar uchun ma'lumotni tasavvur qilish imkonini beradi.

src_text: You can edit one of the available templates or create your own project from scratch by selecting any of the themes provided in the Themes tab.

src_text: You will be able to choose colors and sizes of objects, labels, and the location of visual elements on the slide.

src_text: Pablo is a great website for marketers who often work with social media graphic content and want to improve their projects.

src_text: This is one of the best Canva alternatives with an understandable website, where you can use offered images, as well as upload your own ones.

src_text: It doesn’t matter if you are a professional graphic designer or a beginner, Gravit is suitable for everyone!

src_text: Gravit Designer is a free web-based vector design software, which is not only a Canva alternative but also an Adobe Illustrator alternative.

src_text: Also, when you are done with your project, you can download it as a completely transparent PNG, JPG, SVG, or PDF file.

src_text: All you have to do is to drag its slider until the photo is blurry enough.

src_text: You can combine blur with other image effects that you can find in the pop-up window.

src_text: It has many free photos and templates that you can use to create invitations, banners, cards, Facebook posts, tweets, as well as business logos.

src_text: Since there are no monthly restrictions, you will have problems only if you are struggling with the creative block.

src_text: Desygner provides an easy way to drag and drop photos.

src_text: You can change photos, fonts, text, and colors effortlessly.

src_text: The free forever plan has some restrictions, and the Premium plan costs $9.99 per month and provides full access to all its features.

src_text: In addition, you will be able to save your results in JPG or PNG format.

src_text: Although Spark is not as powerful as some other more advanced tools offered by the company, it’s quite easy to use as more attention is paid to automation and less to creative control.

src_text: Adobe Spark offers tools to help users create posts, pages, and videos.

src_text: Another advantage is that Adobe Spark free gives you access to additional features, such as adding your own graphic design to your graphics, creating branded templates, as well as phone and chat support.

src_text: For users who already have an Adobe Creative Cloud account, all Spark features are already included in their subscription.

src_text: It applies simple to use technology and has a convenient user interface.

src_text: Thus, the influence of English architecture spread across the world.

src_text: Programs designed to monitor users' web browsing, display unsolicited advertisements, or redirect affiliate marketing revenues are called spyware.

src_text: Spyware programs do not spread like viruses; instead they are generally installed by exploiting security holes.

src_text: Ransomware prevents a user from accessing their files until a ransom is paid.

src_text: Stuxnet, for example, was designed to disrupt very specific industrial equipment.
tgt_text: Masalan, Stuxnet juda aniq sanoat uskunalarini buzish uchun moʻljallangan.

src_text: A Trojan horse usually carries a hidden destructive function that is activated when the application is started.

src_text: Unlike computer viruses and worms, Trojan horses generally do not attempt to inject themselves into other files or otherwise propagate themselves.[42]

src_text: Typically, antivirus software can combat malware in the following ways:

src_text: This type of malware protection works the same way as that of antivirus protection in that the anti-malware software scans all incoming network data for malware and blocks any threats it comes across.
tgt_text: Zararli dasturlardan himoyalanishning bu turi virusga qarshi himoya bilan bir xil ishlaydi, chunki zararli dasturlarga qarshi dastur barcha kiruvchi tarmoq maʼlumotlarini zararli dasturlarga skanerlaydi va u duch kelgan har qanday tahdidlarni bloklaydi.

src_text: Typically, when an infected file is found, execution is stopped and the file is quarantined to prevent further damage with the intention to prevent irreversible system damage.
tgt_text: Odatda, zararlangan fayl topilganda, ijro etish toʻxtatiladi va tizimning qaytarib boʻlmaydigan shikastlanishining oldini olish maqsadida fayl keyingi zararni oldini olish uchun karantinga qoʻyiladi.

src_text: Most AVs allow users to override this behaviour.

src_text: While many modern retailers sell copies of Indian patterns, the most respectful way to buy a Navajo style rug is to buy it from Navajo artisans who make carpets.

src_text: In other parts of the word, there are draughts and floods, earthquakes and tsunamis and these so-called natural disasters can do untold damage to a tourism industry.
tgt_text: So'zning boshqa qismlarida qoralama va suv toshqini, zilzila va tsunami bor va bu tabiiy ofatlar sayyohlik sanoatiga juda katta zarar etkazishi mumkin.

src_text: Unfortunately, we cannot control the weather or climatic conditions, but it is a good idea to prepare for earthquakes, tornadoes and hurricanes/typhoons or forest fires before they happen.
tgt_text: Afsuski, biz ob -havo yoki iqlim sharoitini nazorat qila olmaymiz, lekin zilzilalar, tornado va bo'ronlar/tayfunlar yoki o'rmon yong'inlari sodir bo'lishidan oldin ularga tayyorgarlik ko'rish maqsadga muvofiqdir.

src_text: To help you prepare I offer the following suggestions.
tgt_text: Tayyorlashga yordam berish uchun men quyidagi takliflarni taklif qilaman.

src_text: -Develop plans before the disasters occur.
tgt_text: -Tabiiy ofatlar sodir bo'lishidan oldin rejalar tuzing.

src_text: Take the time to plan when things are less chaotic and you have the patience and time to interact with others such as fire departments, police departments, health officials, and experts in emergency management.
tgt_text: Ishlar tartibsizroq bo'lganda rejalashtirishga vaqt ajrating va sizda yong'in bo'linmalari, politsiya bo'limlari, sog'liqni saqlash xodimlari va favqulodda vaziyatlar bo'yicha mutaxassislar kabi boshqalar bilan muloqot qilish uchun sabr -toqat va vaqt bor.

src_text: Get to know these people by name and make sure that they know who you are.
tgt_text: Bu odamlar bilan tanishing va ular sizning kimligingizni bilishiga ishonch hosil qiling.

src_text: Make sure that the police department is part of the disaster plan, not only from the perspective of law enforcement but also from the perspective of public relations and economic recovery.
tgt_text: Politsiya bo'limi nafaqat huquqni muhofaza qilish nuqtai nazaridan, balki jamoatchilik bilan aloqalar va iqtisodiy tiklanish nuqtai nazaridan ham ofatlar rejasining bir qismi ekanligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

src_text: What your police department says and how it acts toward visitors may impact your recovery and local tourism industry for years to come.
tgt_text: Sizning politsiya bo'limingiz nima deyishi va tashrif buyuruvchilarga qanday munosabatda bo'lishi kelgusi yillar davomida sizning tiklanishingizga va mahalliy turizm sohasiga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

src_text: -Develop good communication between first responder agencies.
tgt_text: -Birinchi yordam agentliklari o'rtasida yaxshi muloqotni rivojlantirish.

src_text: For example, in case of emergency, will hotels cooperate on allowing the names of guests to be released?
tgt_text: Masalan, favqulodda holatlarda, mehmonxonalar mehmonlarning ismlarini e'lon qilishga ruxsat beradimi?

src_text: If so, under what circumstances?
tgt_text: Agar shunday bo'lsa, qanday sharoitda?

src_text: When should health records be released and what is the responsibility of the local tourism industry regarding privacy versus public health issues?
tgt_text: Sog'liqni saqlash yozuvlari qachon chiqarilishi kerak va maxfiylik va sog'liqni saqlash muammolariga nisbatan mahalliy turizm sanoatining javobgarligi nimada?

src_text: -Know or have a plan if your tourism industry covers a regional or multi-jurisdictional area.
tgt_text: -Agar sizning sayyohlik sohangiz mintaqaviy yoki ko'p yurisdiksiyali hududni qamrab olsa, biling yoki rejangiz bor.

src_text: Whenever possible, develop a code of conduct and a working relationship between agencies, hotels, restaurants, emergency shelters, and other relief agencies that cross city, county, provincial or state boundaries.
tgt_text: Iloji boricha, shahar, tuman, viloyat yoki shtat chegaralarini kesib o'tuvchi agentliklar, mehmonxonalar, restoranlar, favqulodda boshpanalar va boshqa yordam agentliklari o'rtasida xulq -atvor kodeksi va ish munosabatlarini ishlab chiqing.

src_text: The program should also include such things as working with mental health professionals and establishing support facilities for visitors who happen to be survivors.

src_text: Only licensed professionals are qualified to help you with certain health needs.

src_text: Unlike dietitians, certified nutritionist specialists cannot prescribe diets as formal treatment for medical conditions, and they don’t work in hospitals or health clinics.

src_text: But they are qualified to offer general advice on making healthier food choices for your body type and maintaining your ideal weight.

src_text: They typically formulate advice based on health metrics, such as calculating the ideal ratio of macronutrients in your daily diet.

src_text: They often work in private practice and alternative health practices.

src_text: Aristotel Nikomachean Etikasida aytganidek: „Toʻgʻri vaqtda, toʻgʻri narsalar haqida, toʻgʻri odamlarga, toʻgʻri maqsad va toʻgʻri yoʻlda — bu oraliq va eng yaxshi shartdir va bu fazilatga toʻgʻri keladi“.[12] Bu shunchaki ikkita ekstremal oʻrtasidagi farqni ajratish emas.

src_text: Transplantatsiya markazini tanlang
tgt_text: Choose a transplant center

src_text: Sizga va sizning shifokorlaringizga sizga eng mos keladigan transplantatsiya markazini tanlashda yordam berish uchun biz AQSh transplantatsiya markazlari haqida batafsil ma'lumot beramiz.
tgt_text: We provide detailed information on U.S. transplant centers to help you and your doctors choose the transplant center that is best for you.

src_text: Transplantatsiya markazi - bu qon yoki ilik transplantatsiyasi dasturiga ega bo'lgan shifoxona.
tgt_text: A transplant center is a hospital that has a blood or marrow transplant program.

src_text: Ushbu markazlarning aksariyati NMDP* tarmog'ining bir qismidir, shuning uchun ular sifatli parvarish bo'yicha maxsus ko'rsatmalarga javob beradi.
tgt_text: Many of these centers are part of the NMDP* Network so they meet specific guidelines for quality care.

src_text: NMDP tarmog'ida ko'plab xalqaro transplantatsiya markazlari ham mavjud.
tgt_text: There are also many international transplant centers in the NMDP Network.

src_text: Sizga eng mos keladigan markazni topish uchun, shifokoringiz va sug'urta kompaniyangiz bilan hamkorlik qiling.
tgt_text: To find a center that is best for you, work with your doctor and insurance company.

src_text: Transplantatsiya markazini tanlashda ba'zi muhim omillar quyidagilardir:
tgt_text: Some important factors in choosing a transplant center include:

src_text: Sug'urta qoplamasi - Sizning sug'urta kompaniyangiz ma'lum transplantatsiya markaziga borishingizni talab qilishi mumkin.
tgt_text: Insurance coverage – Your insurance company may require you go to a certain transplant center.

src_text: Sizning shifokoringiz - Shifokoringiz maxsus transplantatsiya markazlarini tavsiya qilishi mumkin.
tgt_text: Your doctor – Your doctor may recommend specific transplant centers.

src_text: Ularning xarajatlari haqida ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun transplantatsiya markazining moliyaviy koordinatori bilan bog'laning.
tgt_text: Contact the transplant center financial coordinator to learn more about their costs.

src_text: Transplantatsiya markazi sizning uyingizdan qanchalik uzoqda ekanligini o'ylab ko'ring.
tgt_text: Consider how far the transplant center is from your home.

src_text: Siz va qarovchingiz uchun arzon uy-joy imkoniyatlari mavjudligini bilish uchun transplantatsiya markaziga murojaat qiling.
tgt_text: Contact the transplant center to see if there are low cost housing options for you and your caregiver.

src_text: Vaqtning davomiyligi sizning vaziyatingizga qarab farq qilishi mumkin.
tgt_text: The length of time can vary depending on your situation.

src_text: Ushbu xizmatlarning aksariyati markaz ro'yxatida yoki ular haqida ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun transplantatsiya markaziga murojaat qilishingiz mumkin.
tgt_text: Many of these services are in the center listing or you can contact the transplant center to learn more about them.

src_text: Transplantatsiya markazi sizning kasalligingiz bilan qancha bemorni davolaganini bilib oling.
tgt_text: Find out how many patients with your disease that transplant center has treated.

src_text: Transplantatsiya markazi haqida ko'proq bilish uchun markazga murojaat qilish va aniq savollar berish foydali bo'ladi.
tgt_text: To learn more about a transplant center it is helpful to contact the center and ask specific questions.

src_text: Quyidagi savollarga javoblarni yig'ish uchun Transplantatsiya markazi ish varag'idan (PDF) foydalaning:
tgt_text: Use the Transplant Center Worksheet (PDF) to gather the answers to some of these questions:

src_text: - Bemor transplantatsiya jarayonida bir xil transplantatsiya shifokoriga murojaat qiladimi?
tgt_text: - Does a patient see the same transplant doctor throughout the transplant process?

src_text: - O'rtacha kasalxonada qolish muddati qancha?
tgt_text: - How long is the average hospital stay?

src_text: Mehmonlar yoki ota-onalar bir kechada qolishlari mumkinmi?
tgt_text: Can guests or parents stay overnight?

src_text: Repetitorlik xizmatlari mavjudmi?
tgt_text: Are tutoring services available?

src_text: - Bemorlar yoki parvarish qiluvchilar o'z xonalaridan Internetga ulana oladimi?
tgt_text: - Are patients or caregivers able to connect to the Internet from their rooms?

src_text: AQSh Sog'liqni saqlash va odamlarga xizmat ko'rsatish departamenti (HRSA) AQShda o'tkazilgan transplantatsiyalar uchun bemorlarning omon qolishi va transplantatsiyasi to'g'risida ma'lumotlarga ega, ular orasida kasallikning 100 kunlik, 1 yillik va 3 yillik omon qolishi kiradi.
tgt_text: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HRSA) has patient survival and transplant data for transplants done in the U.S. These include 100-day, 1-year and 3-year survival by disease.

src_text: *Miliy iligi donorlari dasturi (NMDP) tarmog'i AQSh va butun dunyodagi transplantatsiya markazlarini o'z ichiga oladi.
tgt_text: *The National Marrow Donor Program® (NMDP) Network includes transplant centers in the U.S. and around the world.

src_text: Bizning BMT Bemor Navigatorlarimiz transplantatsiya markazini tanlash bo'yicha savollaringizga javob berishlari mumkin.

src_text: Agar biron bir kasallik, masalan, qon yoki immunitet tizimiga zarar etkazsa, tananing sog'lom qon hujayralarini yaratishiga to'sqinlik qilsa, odamga suyak iligi transplantatsiyasi kerak bo'ladi.
tgt_text: If a medical condition — such as one that damages the blood or immune system — prevents the body from creating healthy blood cells, a person may need a bone marrow transplant.

src_text: Quyidagi holatlardan biriga ega bo'lgan odam suyak iligi transplantatsiyasiga nomzod bo'lishi mumkin:
tgt_text: A person with any of the following conditions may be a candidate for a bone marrow transplant:

src_text: - kemoterapi yoki saraton uchun radiatsiya terapiyasi tufayli suyak iligi shikastlanishi
tgt_text: - bone marrow damage due to chemotherapy or radiation therapy for cancer

src_text: Sog'lom suyak iligi hujayralari qaerdan kelib chiqqanligiga qarab, suyak iligi transplantatsiyasining uchta turi mavjud.
tgt_text: There are three types of bone marrow transplant, based on where the healthy bone marrow cells come from.

src_text: Ko'p hollarda donor yaqin oila a'zosi, masalan, aka-uka yoki ota-onadir.
tgt_text: In many cases, the donor is a close family member, such as a sibling or parent.

src_text: Autolog transplantatsiya deb nomlangan protsedurada, shifokor davolanayotgan odamdan sog'lom qonli ildiz hujayralarini oladi va namunadagi shikastlangan hujayralarni olib tashlagach, keyinchalik bu hujayralarni almashtiradi.
tgt_text: In a procedure called an autologous transplant, the doctor will take healthy blood stem cells from the person being treated and replace these cells later, after removing any damaged cells in the sample.

src_text: Suyak iligi transplantatsiyasidan oldin shifokor eng yaxshi protsedura turini aniqlash uchun testlarni o'tkazadi.
tgt_text: Before a bone marrow transplant, the doctor will run tests to determine the best type of procedure.

src_text: Keyin odam kimyoterapiya, radiatsiya yoki ikkalasining kombinatsiyasini o'z ichiga olishi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa davolanishdan o'tadi.
tgt_text: The person will then undergo other treatment, which may involve chemotherapy, radiation, or a combination of the two.

src_text: Ushbu protseduralar odatda suyak iligi hujayralarini, shuningdek saraton hujayralarini yo'q qiladi.
tgt_text: These procedures typically destroy bone marrow cells as well as cancer cells.

src_text: Suyak iligi transplantatsiyasini olgan odam, aslida, DNKning ikkita potentsial manbaiga ega bo'larmidi, asl nusxasi tananing hujayralarida, keyin suyak iligining donor hujayralaridan.
tgt_text: Would a person who receives a bone marrow transplant essentially now have two potential sources of DNA, the original pre-existing in the body's cells and now another from the donor cells of the bone marrow?

src_text: Siz to'g'ri aytasiz.
tgt_text: You are exactly right.

src_text: Aytmoqchi bo'lganim shundaki, ularning qonidagi DNK qolgan hujayralardagi DNKdan farq qiladi.
tgt_text: What I mean is that the DNA in their blood is different than the DNA in the rest of their cells.

src_text: Nazariy jihatdan, bu jinoiy tergovni murakkablashtirishi mumkin.
tgt_text: In theory, this could complicate a criminal investigation.

src_text: Bundan tashqari, tug'ilish muammolarini aniqlash uchun ham foydalanish mumkin.
tgt_text: It can also be used to figure out fertility issues.

src_text: DNK tekshiruvi juda oz miqdordagi inson sochlari, suyaklari, teri to'qimalari, tupurik, sperma va qondan DNK yig'ish yo'li bilan amalga oshirilishi mumkin.
tgt_text: DNA testing can be done by collecting DNA from very small amounts of human hair, bone, skin tissue, saliva, semen, and blood.

src_text: Olimlar DNKimizda odamlar o'rtasida juda farq qiladigan 13 joyni aniqladilar.
tgt_text: Scientists have identified 13 places on our DNA that are very different between individuals.

src_text: Ular bir odamni boshqasidan ajrata oladigan profillarni ishlab chiqarish uchun o'sha joylardan foydalanadilar.
tgt_text: They use those areas to produce profiles that can distinguish one individual from another.

src_text: Ba'zida odamlar ikki xil DNK to'plami bilan tug'iladi (ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun shu erni bosing).
tgt_text: Sometimes people are born with two different sets of DNA (click here to learn more).

src_text: Va ba'zida odamda keyinchalik hayotda turli xil DNKlar paydo bo'ladi.
tgt_text: And sometimes a person develops different DNA later in life.

src_text: Vaqt o'tishi bilan ba'zi hujayralarimizda sodir bo'ladigan kichik DNK o'zgarishlari oddiy misol.
tgt_text: A common example is small DNA changes that happen in some of our cells over time.

src_text: Mozaika odatda muammo emas, chunki DNK testlari 13 xil nuqtani ko'rib chiqadi.
tgt_text: Mosaics usually aren't a problem because DNA tests look at 13 different spots.

src_text: U turli qon va suyak iligi kasalliklari bilan og'rigan odamlarni davolashi mumkin.
tgt_text: It can treat people with various blood and bone marrow diseases.

src_text: Bundan tashqari, u saratonning ayrim shakllarini davolashda ishlatiladi.
tgt_text: It is also used in the treatment of some forms of cancer.

src_text: Bu ko'pincha kimyoterapiya yoki nurlanish yordamida amalga oshiriladi.
tgt_text: This is often done with chemotherapy or radiation.

src_text: Bu qon hujayralari bizning qonimizni ishlab chiqarish uchun javobgardir.
tgt_text: These blood stem cells are responsible for making our blood.

src_text: Nyu Jersi iqtisodiyotida[tahrir | manbasini tahrirlash]
tgt_text: In the New Jersey economy[edit]

src_text: Wall street firmalari 1980-yillarda Nyu-Jersi shtatida gʻarbga yoʻnalganidan soʻng[67] Wall street faoliyatining toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri iqtisodiy taʼsiri Nyu-York shahridan tashqariga chiqdi.
tgt_text: After Wall Street firms started to expand westward in the 1980s into New Jersey,[80] the direct economic impacts of Wall Street activities have gone beyond New York City.

src_text: Moliyaviy xizmatlar sanoatida, asosan, „arka ofis“ rollarida bandlik Nyu-Jersi iqtisodiyotining muhim qismiga aylandi[68]. 2009-yilda Wall streetdagi ish haqi shtatda deyarli 18,5 milliard dollar miqdorida toʻlangan.
tgt_text: The employment in the financial services industry, mostly in the "back office" roles, has become an important part of New Jersey's economy.[81] In 2009, the Wall Street employment wages were paid in the amount of almost $18.5 billion in the state.

src_text: Sanoat oʻsha yili Nyu-Jersi yalpi ichki mahsulotiga 39,4 milliard dollar yoki 8,4 foiz hissa qoʻshdi[69].
tgt_text: The industry contributed $39.4 billion or 8.4 percent to the New Jersey's gross domestic product in the same year.[82]

src_text: Bundan tashqari, Nyu-Jersi Wall street operatsiyalarini qoʻllab-quvvatlash uchun asosiy texnologik infratuzilmaga aylandi.
tgt_text: Additionally, New Jersey has become the main technology infrastructure to support the Wall Street operations.

src_text: Shtat 2007-yildan 2010-yilgacha boʻlgan davrda ipoteka inqirozi natijasida moliyaviy xizmatlar sohasida bandlik bazasining 7,9 foizini yoʻqotgan[69].
tgt_text: The state lost 7.9 percent of its employment base from 2007 to 2010 in the financial services sector in the fallout of the subprime mortgage crisis.[82]

src_text: Wilson amaldagi respublikachi William Howard Taft va uchinchi partiya nomzodi Theodore Rooseveltni yengib, 1912-yilgi Amerika Qo‘shma Shtatlari prezidentlik saylovlarida osonlik bilan g‘alaba qozondi va 1848-yildan buyon buni amalga oshirgan birinchi janublik bo‘ldi.

src_text: Uning birinchi asosiy ustuvorligi 1913-yilgi Daromad toʻgʻrisidagi qonun boʻlib, u tariflarni pasaytirdi va zamonaviy daromad soligʻini boshladi.

src_text: 1914-yilda Birinchi jahon urushi boshlanganda, Wilson ittifoqchilar va markaziy kuchlar oʻrtasida tinchlik muzokaralarini olib borishga harakat qilganda, AQSh betarafligini eʼlon qildi.

src_text: Tomas Woodrow Wilson Virjiniya shtatining Staunton shahrida shotland-irland va shotland oilasida tugʻilgan.[1] U toʻrt farzandning uchinchisi va Jozef Ruggles Wilson va Jessi Janet Woodrowning birinchi oʻgʻli edi.

src_text: Wilsonning ota-bobosi va buvisi 1807-yilda Irlandiyaning Tyrone okrugidagi Strabane shahridan Qoʻshma Shtatlarga koʻchib, Ogayo shtatining Steubenville shahrida joylashdilar.

src_text: Toʻydan koʻp oʻtmay, Jozef Presviterian pastori etib tayinlangan va Stauntonda xizmat qilish uchun tayinlangan.[4] Tomas Jozef xizmat qilgan Staunton Birinchi Presviterian cherkovining Manse uyida tugʻilgan.
tgt_text: Soon after the wedding, Joseph was ordained as a Presbyterian pastor and assigned to serve in Staunton.[4] Thomas was born in the Manse, a house of the Staunton First Presbyterian Church where Joseph served.

src_text: U ikki yoshga toʻlmasdan oldin, oila Jorjiyaning Augusta shahriga koʻchib oʻtdi.

src_text: Da chop etilgan yangi tadqiqotda Tabiat o'simliklari, Yaponiyaning Nagoya universiteti tadqiqotchilari azot ochligiga javoban nitrat olish mexanizmini faollashtirish uchun kalit bo'lgan o'simlik fermentini aniqladilar.
tgt_text: In a new study published in Nature Plants, researchers at Nagoya University, Japan, have identified a plant enzyme that is key to activating a nitrate uptake mechanism in response to nitrogen starvation.

src_text: Ushbu topilma o'simliklar qiyin sharoitlarda o'z ehtiyojlarini qanday qondirishini tushuntiradi va bunday muhitda qishloq xo'jaligini yaxshilash uchun eshiklarni ochadi.
tgt_text: This finding explains how plants meet their needs in challenging environments, opening doors to improving agriculture in such environments.

src_text: Qizig'i shundaki, qachon Arabidopsis o'simliklar NRT2.1 oqsilini sintez qiladi, ular dastlab faol bo'lmagan oqsilni ishlab chiqaradi, keyinchalik yuqori afiniteli transport tizimi kerak bo'lganda faollashishi mumkin.
tgt_text: Interestingly, when Arabidopsis plants synthesize the NRT2.1 protein, they initially produce an inactive protein that can later be activated when the high-affinity transport system is needed.

src_text: Boshqacha qilib aytadigan bo'lsak, azot tanqisligi ushbu oqsillardan foydalanishni talab qilishidan oldin o'simliklar yuqori afinitetli transport tizimidagi oqsillarni sintez qilishi kerak, chunki azot etishmasligining o'zi yangi oqsillarni sintez qilishni qiyinlashtiradi.
tgt_text: In other words, plants need to synthesize the proteins in a high-affinity transport system before a nitrogen deficiency necessitates the use of those proteins, because nitrogen deficiency itself makes it difficult to synthesize new proteins.

src_text: Ushbu ajoyib tizimni yaxshiroq tushunish uchun doktor Matsubayashi va uning hamkasblari azot ochligiga javoban NRT2.1 ni faollashtiradigan oqsilni aniqlashga kirishdilar.
tgt_text: In order to better understand this remarkable system, Dr. Matsubayashi and his colleagues set out to identify the protein that activates NRT2.1 in response to nitrogen starvation.

src_text: Tez orada ularning tajribalari e'tiborini At4g32950 nomli oqsilga qaratdi.
tgt_text: Their experiments soon drew their attention to a protein called At4g32950.

src_text: Bu faollikka NRT2.1 oqsilining ma'lum bir joyidan fosfat guruhini olib tashlash orqali erishadi, shuning uchun tergovchilar At4g32950 oqsiliga yangi nom berishga qaror qilishdi: CEPD-induktsiyali fosfataza yoki qisqacha "CEPH".
tgt_text: It achieves this activation by removing a phosphate group from a specific location on the NRT2.1 protein, so the investigators decided to give the At4g32950 protein a new name: CEPD-induced phosphatase, or "CEPH" for short.

src_text: Umuman olganda, bu natijalar shuni ko'rsatadiki, CEPH azot ochligiga NRT2.1 oqsilini faollashtirish orqali javob berishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynaydi.
tgt_text: Collectively, these results indicate that CEPH plays a critical role in responding to nitrogen starvation through its activation of the NRT2.1 protein.

src_text: Doktor Matsubayashi CEPHda katta potentsial foydani genetik muhandislik vositasi sifatida ko'radi, chunki u ta'kidlaganidek, "CEPH faolligini sun'iy ravishda oshirish olimlarga hatto ozuqa moddalari past bo'lgan tuproqlarda ham o'sadigan o'simliklarni yaratishga imkon beradi".
tgt_text: Dr. Matsubayashi sees considerable potential utility in CEPH as a genetic engineering tool, as he notes, "Artificially enhancing CEPH activity could enable scientists to create plants that grow even in soils with low nutrient levels."

src_text: Tarixan, yulduzlar dunyo tamaddunlari uchun muhim boʻlib kelgan.
tgt_text: Historically, stars have been important to civilizations throughout the world.

src_text: Nega bu yulduzlar Quyosh tizimiga sezilarli gravitatsiyaviy taʼsir etmasligini izohlash uchun Isaac Newton yulduzlar barcha yoʻnalishda teng tarqalgan, deb taxmin qilgan, bu taxminni teolog Richard Bentley maʼqullagan.[26]
tgt_text: To explain why these stars exerted no net gravitational pull on the Solar System, Isaac Newton suggested that the stars were equally distributed in every direction, an idea prompted by the theologian Richard Bentley.[27]

src_text: Yulduz spektroskopiyasi faniga Joseph von Fraunhofer va Angelo Secchi asos solishgan.
tgt_text: The science of stellar spectroscopy was pioneered by Joseph von Fraunhofer and Angelo Secchi.

src_text: Qoʻshaloq yulduzlar orbitasini teleskop kuzatuvlaridan chiqarish muammosini birinchi boʻlib Felix Savary 1827-yili hal qildi.[29] Yigirmanchi asrda yulduzlarni ilmiy oʻrganish keskin rivojlandi.
tgt_text: The first solution to the problem of deriving an orbit of binary stars from telescope observations was made by Felix Savary in 1827.[30] The twentieth century saw increasingly rapid advances in the scientific study of stars.

src_text: 1600-yillarda yulduz turkumlari nomlari osmonning tegishli hududlaridagi yulduzlarni nomlashda ishlatildi.
tgt_text: Circa 1600, the names of the constellations were used to name the stars in the corresponding regions of the sky.

src_text: Olmon astronomi Johann Bayer qator yulduz xaritalarini yaratib, har bir yulduz turkumidagi yulduzlarni belgilash uchun yunon harflarini ishlatdi.
tgt_text: The German astronomer Johann Bayer created a series of star maps and applied Greek letters as designations to the stars in each constellation.

src_text: Yulduz parametrlarini SI yoki SGS birliklari orqali ifoda etish mumkin boʻlsa-da, massa, yorqinlik va radiuslarni Quyosh xarakteristikalariga asoslanib ifodalash qulayroqdir:
tgt_text: Although stellar parameters can be expressed in SI units or CGS units, it is often most convenient to express mass, luminosity, and radii in solar units, based on the characteristics of the Sun:

src_text: Globula ham siqilib, zichlik oshgach, gravitatsiyaviy energiya issiqlikka aylanib, harorat koʻtariladi.
tgt_text: As a globule collapses and the density increases, the gravitational energy converts into heat and the temperature rises.

src_text: Gravitatsiyaviy siqilish davri 10-15 million yil davom etadi.
tgt_text: The period of gravitational contraction lasts about 10 to 15 million years.

src_text: Gigant sifatida Quyosh hozirgi massasining 30% ini yoʻqotadi.[58][65]
tgt_text: As a giant, the Sun will lose roughly 30% of its current mass.[63][71]

src_text: Yerga Quyoshdan keyin eng yaqin yulduz Proxima Centauri boʻlib, u 39,9 trillion km yoki 4,2 yorugʻlik yili uzoqlikdadir.
tgt_text: The nearest star to the Earth, apart from the Sun, is Proxima Centauri, which is 39.9 trillion kilometres, or 4.2 light-years away.

src_text: Aksariyat yulduzlar 1-10 milliard yoshda.
tgt_text: Most stars are between 1 billion and 10 billion years old.

src_text: Quyosh ham yulduz, biroq u Yerga disk boʻlib koʻrinish va kun yorugʻini berish uchun yetarlicha yaqindir.
tgt_text: The Sun is also a star, but it is close enough to the Earth to appear as a disk instead, and to provide daylight.

src_text: Biroq Betelgeyzening zichligi Quyoshnikidan ancha past.[93]
tgt_text: Betelgeuse, however, has a much lower density than the Sun.[97]

src_text: Yulduzning Quyoshga nisbatan harakati yulduz kelib chiqishi va yoshi, shuningdek uning atrofidagi galaktika tuzilishi va evolutsiyasi haqida foydali maʼlumot berishi mumkin.
tgt_text: The motion of a star relative to the Sun can provide useful information about the origin and age of a star, as well as the structure and evolution of the surrounding galaxy.

src_text: Harakatining ikkala qiymatlari aniqlangach, yulduzning Quyoshga yoki galaktikaga nisbatan fazoviy tezligi hisoblanishi mumkin boʻladi.
tgt_text: Once both rates of movement are known, the space velocity of the star relative to the Sun or the galaxy can be computed.

src_text: 2006-yilga koʻra eng katta absolut yulduz kattaligiga ega yulduz LBV 1806-20 boʻlib, magnitudasi −14,2 ga teng.
tgt_text: As of 2006, the star with the highest known absolute magnitude is LBV 1806-20, with a magnitude of −14.2.

src_text: Bu yulduz Quyoshdan kamida 5 000 000 marta yorqinroq.[128] Bizga maʼlum yorqinligi eng kam yulduzlar NGC 6397 klasterida joylashgan.
tgt_text: This star is at least 5,000,000 times more luminous than the Sun.[131] The least luminous stars that are currently known are located in the NGC 6397 cluster.

src_text: Ulardan eng keng tarqalganlari L va T boʻlib, bu sinflarga eng sovuq kichik massali yulduzlar va jigarrang mittilar kiradi.
tgt_text: The most common of these are types L and T, which classify the coldest low-mass stars and brown dwarfs.

src_text: Biroq ushbu tizim ekstremal yuqori haroratlarda buziladi: O0 va O1 yulduzlar mavjud boʻlmasligi mumkin.[133]
tgt_text: However, this system breaks down at extreme high temperatures: class O0 and O1 stars may not exist.[136]

src_text: Ammo, Wobble gipotezasiga ko'ra, kodonning uchinchi pozitsiyasi va antikodondagi asos bir-birini to'ldiruvchi bo'lishi shart emas (bu 61 ta kodon bo'lishiga qaramay, nima uchun tRNK molekulalarining juda oz turlari mavjudligini tushuntirishga yordam beradi).
tgt_text: But, according to the Wobble Hypothesis, the base on the third position of the codon and that on the anticodon need not be complementary (which helps explain why there are very few types of tRNA molecules, inspite of there being 61 codons).

src_text: Nima uchun mavjud bo'lishi kerakligi haqida ba'zi asoslar mavjud va shuning uchun u hali ham gipoteza deb ataladi.
tgt_text: There are some justifications for why it should exist and that is why it is still called a hypothesis.

src_text: Va bu bayonot to'g'ri emas: "kodonning uchinchi pozitsiyasidagi va antikodondagi asos bir-birini to'ldiruvchi bo'lishi shart emas".
tgt_text: And this statement is not true:"the base on the third position of the codon and that on the anticodon need not be complementary".

src_text: Shunday qilib, tebranish gipotezasi shundan iboratki, antikodonning birinchi bazasi (ko'pincha o'zgartirilgan/atipik nukleobazalar) bog'lanishning nopokligini ko'rsatishi mumkin.
tgt_text: So the statement of wobble hypothesis is that the first base of the anticodon (often is a modified/atypical nucleobase) can show promiscuity of binding.

src_text: The Wobble Gipoteza - yuqorida aytib o'tilganidek - to'g'ri ekanligi aniq ko'rsatilgan.
tgt_text: The Wobble Hypothesis - as stated above - has been unequivocally shown to be correct.

src_text: Shunday qilib, 5'-tRNK antikodon asoslari, G va men chayqalishi mumkin (va C bo'lishi mumkin emas) degan bashorat amalga oshdi.
tgt_text: Thus, the prediction that the 5'-tRNA anticodon bases, G and I could wobble (and C could not) have been borne out.

src_text: Esda tutish kerak bo'lgan narsa shundaki, buning uchun tRNKdagi antikodonning uch o'lchovli tuzilishi (birinchi ikkita bazani asosiy stacking orqali ushlab turadi) va potentsial vodorod bog'lovchi guruhlarning yaqinligi nuqtai nazaridan ilmiy asos bor. turli asoslarda.
tgt_text: The point to remember is that there is a scientific rationale for this in terms of the three-dimensional structure of the anticodon in the tRNA (which holds the first two bases in position by base stacking) and the proximity of the potentially hydrogen-bonding groups in the various bases.

src_text: C yoki U bilan G juftligi har doim ishlaydi, I, A, C yoki G bilan bog‘lash esa blokdagi barcha to‘rtta asos (masalan, Leu, Val, Ser) tomonidan kodlangan aminokislotalar bilan ishlaydi, lekin ikkita blok mavjud bo‘lganda emas (masalan, Tyr, His, Asn).
tgt_text: G pairing with C or U always works, whereas I pairing with A, C or G will work with amino acids encoded by all four bases in a block (e.g. Leu, Val, Ser), but not where there are blocks of two (e.g. Tyr, His, Asn).

src_text: Bularning barchasining kimyoviy asosini ta'kidlaydigan yakuniy nuqta.
tgt_text: One final point that emphasizes the chemical basis of all this.

src_text: Ushbu bo'lim oxirida siz quyidagilarni amalga oshirishingiz mumkin:
tgt_text: By the end of this section, you will be able to:

src_text: Bu protein tuzilishi va funktsiyasining ajoyib o'zgarishiga olib keladigan aminokislotalar yon zanjirlarining xilma-xilligi.
tgt_text: It is the variety of amino acid side chains that gives rise to the incredible variation of protein structure and function.

src_text: Keyingi tekshiruvlar quyidagi jadvalda tavsiflanganidek, uchlik kodning mavjudligini isbotladi.
tgt_text: Further investigation proved the existence of a triplet code as described in the table below.

src_text: Juda ko'p birikmalar va atigi 20 ta aminokislotalar bilan hujayra boshqa imkoniyatlar bilan nima qiladi?
tgt_text: With so many combinations and only 20 amino acids, what does the cell do with the other possibilities?

src_text: Uchta to'xtash kodonlari ham so'zlashuv nomlariga ega: UAA (oxra), UAG (qahrabo), UGA (opal), UAA prokaryotik genlarda eng keng tarqalgan.
tgt_text: The three stop codons also have colloquial names: UAA (ochre), UAG (amber), UGA (opal), with UAA being the most common in prokaryotic genes.

src_text: To'xtash kodonlari ba'zan hozirda 21 va 22-chi aminokislotalar, selenosistein (UGA) va pirrolizin (UAG) deb hisoblangan narsalarni kodlash uchun ham ishlatiladi.
tgt_text: The stop codons are sometimes also used to encode what are now considered the 21 st and 22 nd amino acids, selenocysteine (UGA) and pyrrolysine (UAG).

src_text: Ushbu aminokislotalar prokarya va arxeyaning ba'zi turlarida doimiy ravishda kodlanganligi aniqlangan.
tgt_text: These amino acids have been discovered to be consistently encoded in some species of prokarya and archaea.

src_text: E'tibor bering, maxsus boshlang'ich kodonlar mavjud emas: buning o'rniga, vaziyatga qarab metionin va tarjima boshlanishi uchun AUG kodlari, darhol tushuntirilgan.
tgt_text: Note that there are no dedicated start codons: instead, AUG codes for both methionine and the start of translation, depending on the circumstance, as explained forthwith.

src_text: Genetik kodda boshqa kichik o'zgarishlar ham mavjud, ammo kodning universalligi saqlanib qolmoqda.
tgt_text: Other minor alterations to the genetic code exist as well, but the universality of the code in general remains.

src_text: Ushbu o'zgarishlarning ko'pchiligi Milliy Biotexnologiya Axborot Markazi (NCBI) tomonidan mos ravishda Berklidagi Kaliforniya universiteti (AQSh) va Nagoya (Yaponiya) universitetida Jukes va Osava ishlariga asoslangan holda kataloglangan.
tgt_text: Many of these changes have been cataloged by the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) based on work by Jukes and Osawa at the University of California at Berkeley (USA) and the University of Nagoya (Japan), respectively.

src_text: Ushbu cheklovlarga qaramay, ESClar differentsiatsiya yo'llari haqidagi hozirgi tushunchamizda kuchli vosita ekanligi isbotlangan.
tgt_text: Despite these limitations, ESCs have been proven to be powerful tools in our current understanding of differentiation pathways.

src_text: Nihoyat, kokteyllar yoki individual omillar turli sharoitlarda o'stirilgan hujayralarga ularning nervlarni qo'zg'atuvchi faoliyatini sinab ko'rish uchun taqdim etiladi.
tgt_text: Finally, cocktails or individual factors are presented to cells grown in a variety of conditions to test their neural inducing activities.

src_text: Yuqori organizmlar genomlarida ortiqchalik keng tarqalgan ko'rinadi.
tgt_text: Redundancy seems to be widespread in genomes of higher organisms.

src_text: Ko'rinib turibdiki, ortiqcha genlarga misollar rivojlanish biologiyasi, immunologiya, neyrobiologiya va hujayra siklining ko'plab tadqiqotlaridan olingan.
tgt_text: Examples of apparently redundant genes come from numerous studies of developmental biology, immunology, neurobiology and the cell cycle.

src_text: Shunga qaramay, muammo bor: funktsional oqsillarni kodlaydigan genlar tanlov bosimi ostida bo'lishi kerak.
tgt_text: Yet there is a problem: genes encoding functional proteins must be under selection pressure.

src_text: Biz genetik ortiqchalik nima uchun keng tarqalganligini tushuntira oladigan to'rtta holatni taqdim etamiz.
tgt_text: We present four cases that can explain why genetic redundancy is common.

src_text: Uchta holatda ortiqchalik hatto evolyutsion jihatdan barqarordir.
tgt_text: In three cases, redundancy is even evolutionarily stable.

src_text: Tanlov tomonidan tavsiflanadi x′i = fixi/f, qayerda f = Sixifi aholining o'rtacha jismoniy tayyorgarligini bildiradi.
tgt_text: Selection is described by x′i = fixi/f, where f = Eixifi denotes the average fitness of the population.

src_text: Muayyan genotipning yaroqliligi eng samarali genning samaradorligi bilan ta'minlanadi.
tgt_text: The fitness of a particular genotype is given by the efficacy of the most efficient gene.

src_text: Biroq, ko'p sonli genlar uchun samaradorlik va mutatsiya stavkalari bo'yicha shartlar juda cheklangan bo'ladi.
tgt_text: For a large number of genes, however, the conditions on efficacies and mutation rates become very restrictive.

src_text: Mutatsiyalar B variantga olib kelishi mumkin b1, funktsiyani bajarish qobiliyatini yo'qotgan F1 lekin baribir ijro etadi F2, yoki variantga b2, bu mutlaqo faol bo'lmagan mutatsiya stavkalari ub1 va ub2, mos ravishda.
tgt_text: Mutations in B can either lead to variant b1, which has lost the ability to perform function F1 but still performs F2, or to variant b2, which is completely inactive mutation rates are ub1 and ub2, respectively.

src_text: Gaploid modellar bo'yicha natijalarimiz diploid modellarga ham tegishli.
tgt_text: Our results for haploid models also apply to diploid models.

src_text: Rivojlanish xatolari bo'lgan diploid modellar ham barqaror ortiqchalikni beradi.
tgt_text: Diploid models with developmental errors also give stable redundancy.

src_text: Bunday holatlardan biri Brukfild tomonidan kashf etilgan: u qo'sh geterozigota deb taxmin qiladi, AB/ab, yovvoyi tur kabi mos keladi, AB/AB, lekin Ab/ab, aB/ab va ab/ab 1 .
tgt_text: One such case was discovered by Brookfield: it assumes that the double heterozygote, AB/ab, is as fit as the wild type, AB/AB, but Ab/ab, aB/ab and ab/ab have low fitness 1 .

src_text: Bu kamdan-kam rivojlanish xatolarining natijasi bo'lishi mumkin.
tgt_text: This can be the consequence of rare developmental errors.

src_text: Bir qancha bunday misollar avvalroq muhokama qilingan 5 .
tgt_text: Several such examples have been discussed previously 5 .

src_text: Masalan, ribosoma tunneli kengaytirilgan konformatsiyalar va peptid zanjirining ikkilamchi tuzilmalarini boshqara oladigan naycha vazifasini bajaradi.
tgt_text: For example the ribosome tunnel acts as a tube that can handle extended conformations and secondary structures of the peptide chain.

src_text: Yangi paydo bo'lgan peptidlarning o'ziga xos qoldiqlari tarjima jarayonini sekinlashtiradi yoki to'xtatadi (Kramer va boshq., 2009).
tgt_text: Charge specific residues of nascent peptides slow down or stop the translation process (Kramer et al., 2009).

src_text: Ribosomalar yangi paydo bo'lgan zanjir va uning tunneldagi holati bilan bog'liq signallarni ularning yuzasiga uzatadi va shu bilan SRP bilan o'zaro ta'sirni nazorat qiladi (Walter and Blobel, 1983 Kramer va boshq., 2009).
tgt_text: Ribosomes transmit signals relating the nascent chain and its position in the tunnel to their surface, thereby controlling the interactions with SRP (Walter and Blobel, 1983 Kramer et al., 2009).

src_text: SRP ning eukaryotlarda paydo bo'lgan oqsil bilan bog'lanishi tarjima jarayonini to'xtatishi mumkin (Kramer va boshq., 2009).
tgt_text: The binding of SRP to the nascent protein in eukaryotes can stop the translation process (Kramer et al., 2009).

src_text: Ribosoma va yangi paydo bo'lgan zanjir bilan tetik omilining o'zaro ta'siri ularning uzunligi, ketma-ketligi va katlama holatiga bog'liq (Kaiser va boshq., 2006 Raine va boshq., 2006).
tgt_text: Trigger factor interaction with the ribosome and nascent chain is a function of their length, sequence and folding status (Kaiser et al., 2006 Raine et al., 2006).

src_text: Katlama tezligini kamaytirish orqali in vitro va in vivo, tetik omillari model ko'p domenli substratlarning katlanmasını yaxshilash uchun ko'rsatildi (Agashe va boshq., 2004).
tgt_text: By reducing the rate of folding in vitro and in vivo, trigger factors have been shown to improve the folding of model multi-domain substrates (Agashe et al., 2004).

src_text: Eukaryotlar J, Hsp70, Hsp 40 kabi omillar va boshqa mexanizmlar bilan bir qatorda yangi paydo bo'lgan zanjir bilan bog'liq kompleks (NAC) oqsilga asoslangan tizimlardan foydalanadi.
tgt_text: Eukaryotes use factors such as J, Hsp70, Hsp 40 and nascent chain associated complex (NAC) protein-based systems along with other such mechanisms.

src_text: To'xtatib turish hujayralarga issiqlik stressi kabi o'zgaruvchan muhit sharoitlariga moslashish imkonini beradi.
tgt_text: Pausing allows cells to adapt to changing environmental conditions such as heat stress.

src_text: Ammo, bu omillar, shuningdek, ushbu oqsillarning faolligini yomonlashtiradi (Crombie va boshq., 1992 Komar va boshq., 1999).
tgt_text: But, these factors also adversely reduce the activity of those proteins (Crombie et al., 1992 Komar et al., 1999).

src_text: Pauza joylari CRD c-myc mintaqasida joylashgan va noyob arginin (CGA) va qo'shni treonin (ACA) kodonlari bilan taqqoslanadi (Lemm va Ross, 2002).
tgt_text: The pause sites occur within the CRD c-myc region and map to rare arginine (CGA) and adjacent threonine (ACA) codons (Lemm and Ross, 2002).

src_text: Lemm ma'lumotlari (Lemm va Ross, 2002) pauza joylari CRD ichidagi turli kodonlarda ham paydo bo'lishini ko'rsatadi.
tgt_text: Data from Lemm (Lemm and Ross, 2002) shows that pause sites also occur at different codons within the CRD.

src_text: Bu CGA va ACA kodonlari pauza joyi ekanligi haqidagi da'voni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi (Lemm va Ross, 2002), chunki CGA va ACA pauza hosil qiladi, ularni sinonimik kodonlar bilan almashtirish esa pauza ta'sirini yaratmaydi.
tgt_text: This supports the claim that the CGA and ACA codons are a pause site (Lemm and Ross, 2002), since CGA and ACA produce a pause, while replacing them with synonymous codons produced no pausing effect.

src_text: SD ketma-ketligi odatda AUG boshlang'ich kodonining yuqori oqimida joylashgan (Shine va Dalgarno, 1975).
tgt_text: The SD sequence is generally upstream of the start codon AUG (Shine and Dalgarno, 1975).

src_text: TP hozirgacha juda oz sonli bakterial bo'lmagan turlarda o'rganilgan.

tgt_text: A1: We have reference project in some countries,If we get the permission of the customer who has brought the machines from us ,we can tell you their contact imformation,you can go to vist their factory.

tgt_text: And you are always welcome to come to visit our company,and see the machine running in our factory,we can pick you up from the airport in our city.
